activity-tree.name: ActivityTree
activity-tree.intent: Show an agent run as its plan steps with each tool call nested under the step that made it.

consider.when: people only need the steps and their progress, not the calls behind them
one call is shown on its own in the transcript, with its result
the view is a history of finished checkpoints or revisions

guidance: Pass nodes in run order; a call that matches no step stays where it ran and reads as unassigned.
Only live work shimmers, so a finished run shows no active step and no worker line.

nodes.description: In order: { id; kind: "step" | "call"; label: ReactNode (step text or call "name · argument"); meta?: ReactNode; status?: "done" | "active" | "failed" (steps); running?: boolean (calls); failed?: boolean (calls); unassigned?: boolean (calls) }. Calls follow the step they belong to; an unassigned call sits in run order with the others.

failedLabel.description: Visually hidden status word before a failed step or call.

variant.description: Box emphasis; ghost (default) is the bare tree.

tone.description: Box colour family and call glyph colour.

radius.description: Box radius. Unset keeps xl on a box.

shadow.description: Box elevation. Unset keeps none.

size.description: Row height and type: xs 24 / ui-xs, sm 24 / ui-sm, md 28 / ui-dense, lg 32 / ui.

Calls follow the step they belong to; an unassigned call sits in run order with the others.

shadow.description: Box elevation. Unset keeps none.

tone.description: Box colour family and call glyph colour.

variant.description: Box emphasis; ghost (default) is the bare tree.

ghost = the bare tree (default). solid / soft / outline box it (12px padding, xl radius): solid = opaque fill (surface.base, or the tone soft), soft = tint (neutral.tint or the tone tint), outline = 1px tone border edge. The rows keep their own text colours.

tone.description: Colour family of the box; it also colours the call glyphs with the tone graphic (neutral = text.secondary). Status glyphs keep their meaning (success check, danger alert).

radius.description: Box radius; the default xl is the box's own (a bare tree shows none).

shadow.description: Box elevation; default none.

notes: A flat list: call rows carry data-depth="1" and follow their step, and a visually hidden "Tool call" prefix names the row kind.
Status is text or a glyph, never color alone: check for done, orb plus shimmer for active, the word "running", the help glyph plus the word "Unassigned".
The tree is not a live region by itself; the transcript announces progress. aria-busy is set while a step is active.
Reduced motion stops the orbs and shimmers (the global rule).

examples.title: Activity tree
examples.code:
const nodes: ActivityNode[] = [
  { id: 's1', kind: 'step', status: 'done', label: 'Read theme tokens' },
  { id: 'c1', kind: 'call', label: 'read_tokens · theme/lagoon', meta: '128' },
  { id: 's2', kind: 'step', status: 'done', label: 'Audit contrast' },
  { id: 'c2', kind: 'call', label: 'audit_contrast · 42 pairs', meta: '0 fail' },
  { id: 's3', kind: 'step', status: 'active', label: 'Apply spacing and radius', meta: 'step 3' },
  { id: 'c3', kind: 'call', running: true, label: 'edit_layers · Pricing / Team', meta: 'running' },
  { id: 'c4', kind: 'call', unassigned: true, label: 'screenshot_frame · Checkout', meta: 'Unassigned' },
];

const worker = { name: 'Worker · canvas-editor', meta: 'round 4' };

<ActivityTree nodes={nodes} worker={worker} />

agent-request.name: AgentRequest
agent-request.intent: Let the agent ask the person to decide inline: build a proposed plan, review a batch of changes, or allow an action.

consider.when: the decision must block the whole app until it is answered
the agent asks a clarifying question with a few answer options
the agent reports something that needs no decision

guidance: You own the status: set it once the person answers and the card collapses into a one-line record.
Once a proposal is built, replace it with the Plan or collapse it; keep the pending look for open requests.
When "always" grants more than this one call, say the scope in the subtitle.

tone.description: Unset follows the kind: agent (proposal, review: the spectrum rim, plus the glow on a review), warning (permission tile), success (record), neutral (denied record). proposal / review: any other tone drops the rim for a 1px tone border edge (inset outline); review solid neutral draws none. permission and the record: the tile colour and the soft fill / outline edge.

A new request is announced because the transcript is a live region; the component never moves focus on its own.

parts.name: AppShellTitlebar
parts.description: AppShellTitlebar: banner landmark band, flex row, items centred, 10px gap, height studio titlebar (44), flex none. Holds toolbars, project name, undo / redo, status; the shell does not lay these out further.

parts.name: AppShellStart
parts.description: AppShellStart: region wrapper for the start side (normally a SidePanel with side="start" plus its resize handle). Flex none, min-height 0, display contents when it holds nothing. Medium: unchanged. Compact: absolute inset 0 over the body, z-index chrome, width 100%, so the open panel is a full-screen sheet.

parts.name: AppShellStage
parts.description: AppShellStage: the work surface (canvas, a foundation board). main landmark with aria-label from stageLabel; flex-1, min-width 0, min-height 0, relative, overflow hidden, tabIndex -1 so the skip link can focus it. One sheet: 2xl radius and a 1px border.subtle inset hairline (also drawn by an ::after ring above the content, so a canvas that fills the stage does not cover it), beside the floating panels instead of a square cut into bg.app. Contains the canvas and the overlay.

parts.name: AppShellOverlay
parts.description: AppShellOverlay: absolute inset 0 over the stage, z-index chrome (20, above canvas-overlay 10, below popovers 40), pointer-events none; its direct children get pointer-events auto, so floating toolbars, zoom controls and hints are clickable while the canvas below stays interactive. Children position themselves (for example anchored to edges).

parts.name: AppShellEnd
parts.description: AppShellEnd: region wrapper for the end side (normally a SidePanel side="end"). Flex none, min-height 0. Medium and compact: absolute top 0 / bottom 0 / end 0 over the body, z-index chrome, elevation 3 on the panel it holds (the sheet), width the panel's own width capped at 76% of the body; compact: width 100%.

keyboard.Tab: the skip link is the first tab stop when present, then the titlebar, start region, stage, end region in DOM order (the DOM order is the visual order, so no tabindex is used)
keyboard.Enter: on the skip link: focus the stage

notes: Landmarks: header (banner) for the titlebar, main for the stage, complementary (SidePanel asides) for the regions. The stage aria-label comes from AppShellStage stageLabel, supplied by the app.
The shell does not trap focus or manage modal state. Dialogs and popovers render in portals above it (z-index dialog 60 and popover 40).

In the medium and compact layouts an overlaying region is still ordinary content: it stays in the tab order and reading order. The app collapses it (SidePanel collapsed) when it should not be reachable, which makes it inert.
The root is not a landmark itself; it must not duplicate banner or main.

auto-layout.name: AutoLayout
auto-layout.intent: The auto-layout section of an inspector: flow, alignment, gap, distribution, wrap, padding, clip and grid tracks of a frame.

consider.when: only the alignment pick is needed, not the whole layout section
editing grid columns or rows outside a full layout section

guidance: Place it inside an InspectorSection; it brings no heading or panel frame of its own.
Rows it does not cover (justify, direction, reverse order) go in as children.

invalid.description: K2e: fields the owner marks invalid (a rejected commit, a bound value that needs explicit local intent). Sets aria-invalid="true", data-invalid and the danger edge on that field only; its draft and value stay. Independent of a rejection the part tracks itself through onFieldCommit returning false.

describedBy.description: K2e: id of the owner error or hint text per field (aria-describedby on the field input).

limits.type: Partial<Record<'gap' | 'columnGap' | 'rowGap' | 'paddingTop' | 'paddingRight' | 'paddingBottom' | 'paddingLeft', { min?: number | undefined; max?: number | undefined; step?: number | undefined }>>
limits.description: K2e: per-field range and step from the owner (a size is 0 or more, letter spacing steps 0.1). Defaults are the specimen values. A typed value outside the range is a range draft error in release mode and is clamped in live mode.

children.description: K2e: extra owner rows appended at the end of the controls column (alignment details, direction, include stroke, reverse order, line gap), spaced by the same gap (a details popover trigger, size limits, points, arcs, a transform matrix). They are outside every field contract and render nothing by default.

value.type: { flow: 'free' | 'row' | 'column' | 'grid'; align: string; gap: number; distribution: 'packed' | 'space-between'; wrap: boolean; paddingMode: 'all' | 'axes' | 'sides'; padding: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number }; clip: boolean; columnGap?: number; rowGap?: number; tracks: { size: number | null; unit: 'fr' | 'px' | 'auto' }[] }
value.description: Controlled layout. K2e: columnGap and rowGap, when present and flow is grid, replace the single gap field by two fields (Column gap, Row gap). align is an AlignmentPad value ("middle-left"). Padding is always four sides; the mode only decides how the fields edit it.

defaultValue.type: { flow: 'free' | 'row' | 'column' | 'grid'; align: string; gap: number; distribution: 'packed' | 'space-between'; wrap: boolean; paddingMode: 'all' | 'axes' | 'sides'; padding: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number }; clip: boolean; tracks: { size: number | null; unit: 'fr' | 'px' | 'auto' }[] }
defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial layout; the default is the specimen state.

tone.description: Box colour family and preview outline colour.

variant.description: Box emphasis (ghost = bare).

radius.description: Box radius. Unset keeps xl.

shadow.description: Box elevation. Unset keeps none.

size.description: Spacing: the column gap 8 · 12 · 16 · 20 and the stack gap inside each column 6 · 8 · 12 · 16. The controls keep their own sizes.

preview.description: Shows the live preview above the tracks (docs and onboarding; the studio inspector omits it).

disabled.description: true disables every control (a non-container selection); a record disables the named fields. paddingTop to paddingLeft also name the fields of the all and axes modes (axes edits top and bottom, or left and right, together).

commitMode.description: live (default): the behavior before K2d. release: the NumberField value model for every numeric field of this part, and one commit per continuous gesture.

mixed.description: Fields whose selection values differ; each shows labels.mixed in place of a value (text fields as placeholder, toggles with aria-pressed "mixed", selects as the select value) and never a substituted first value. With a mixed paddingMode the padding fields are mixed too.

reserved.description: Fields that are being written or held by another window: read-only, aria-busy="true", data-reserved, focus and draft kept, no event while reserved.

labels.type: { flowGroup: string; flow: Record<'free' | 'row' | 'column' | 'grid', string>; pad: string; padCells: Record<'top-left' | 'top-center' | 'top-right' | 'middle-left' | 'middle-center' | 'middle-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-center' | 'bottom-right', string>; gap: string; distribution: string; distributionOptions: Record<'packed' | 'space-between', string>; wrap: string; paddingTitle: string; paddingModeGroup: string; paddingMode: Record<'all' | 'axes' | 'sides', string>; paddingAll: string; paddingHorizontal: string; paddingVertical: string; paddingTop: string; paddingRight: string; paddingBottom: string; paddingLeft: string; columnGap?: string; rowGap?: string; clip: string; tracksHeading: string; addTrack: string; track: (index: number) => string; trackUnit: (index: number) => string; trackRemove: (index: number) => string; trackAuto: string; mixed: string }
labels.description: Every text and accessible name of the part and of the parts it composes (AlignmentPad: pad, padCells; GridTracks: tracksHeading, addTrack and the three index functions); no English default. The specimen values: Free, Horizontal, Vertical, Grid; Alignment; Gap; Packed, Space between; Wrap; Padding; All, Axes, Sides; Horizontal padding, Vertical padding; Clip content; Grid tracks; Add column; Track N; Mixed.

commitMode.description: live (default): the behavior before K2d. release: the NumberField value model for every numeric field of this part, and one commit per continuous gesture.

defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial layout; the default is the specimen state.

describedBy.description: K2e: id of the owner error or hint text per field (aria-describedby on the field input).

disabled.description: true disables every control (a non-container selection); a record disables the named fields. paddingTop to paddingLeft also name the fields of the all and axes modes (axes edits top and bottom, or left and right, together).

invalid.description: K2e: fields the owner marks invalid (a rejected commit, a bound value that needs explicit local intent). Sets aria-invalid="true", data-invalid and the danger edge on that field only; its draft and value stay. Independent of a rejection the part tracks itself through onFieldCommit returning false.

labels.description: Every text and accessible name of the part and of the parts it composes (AlignmentPad: pad, padCells; GridTracks: tracksHeading, addTrack and the three index functions); no English default. The specimen values: Free, Horizontal, Vertical, Grid; Alignment; Gap; Packed, Space between; Wrap; Padding; All, Axes, Sides; Horizontal padding, Vertical padding; Clip content; Grid tracks; Add column; Track N; Mixed.

limits.description: K2e: per-field range and step from the owner (a size is 0 or more, letter spacing steps 0.1). Defaults are the specimen values. A typed value outside the range is a range draft error in release mode and is clamped in live mode.

mixed.description: Fields whose selection values differ; each shows labels.mixed in place of a value (text fields as placeholder, toggles with aria-pressed "mixed", selects as the select value) and never a substituted first value. With a mixed paddingMode the padding fields are mixed too.

preview.description: Shows the live preview above the tracks (docs and onboarding; the studio inspector omits it).

radius.description: Box radius. Unset keeps xl.

reserved.description: Fields that are being written or held by another window: read-only, aria-busy="true", data-reserved, focus and draft kept, no event while reserved.

shadow.description: Box elevation. Unset keeps none.

size.description: Spacing: the column gap 8 · 12 · 16 · 20 and the stack gap inside each column 6 · 8 · 12 · 16. The controls keep their own sizes.

tone.description: Box colour family and preview outline colour.

value.description: Controlled layout. K2e: columnGap and rowGap, when present and flow is grid, replace the single gap field by two fields (Column gap, Row gap). align is an AlignmentPad value ("middle-left"). Padding is always four sides; the mode only decides how the fields edit it.

variant.description: Box emphasis (ghost = bare).

ghost = the bare block (own). solid / soft / outline box it with 12px padding and an xl radius: solid = an opaque surface (surface.base, or the tone soft), soft = the tint (neutral.tint or the tone tint), outline = a 1px tone border, no fill. The controls keep their own colours.

tone.description: Colour family of the box and of the preview dashed outline (tone border-strong; accent is the own look).

radius.description: Box radius; default xl (a bare block shows none).

shadow.description: Box elevation; default none.

onFieldFocus.when: K2e: focus enters a field, or a scrub or drag starts on its label (NumberField onScrubStart). The owner acquires that field reservation here. Not raised while the field is reserved or disabled.

onFieldBlur.when: K2e: focus leaves a field after its commit decision. dirty is true while an invalid or uncommitted draft stays in it, so the owner keeps the reservation and the selection guard.

onFieldCommit.payload: { field: 'gap' | 'columnGap' | 'rowGap'; value: number } | { field: 'paddingTop' | 'paddingRight' | 'paddingBottom' | 'paddingLeft'; value: number; sides: ('top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left')[] } | { field: 'flow' | 'align' | 'distribution' | 'paddingMode'; value: string } | { field: 'wrap' | 'clip'; value: boolean } | { field: 'tracks'; value: { size: number | null; unit: 'fr' | 'px' | 'auto' }[] }
onFieldCommit.when: K2e: exactly one field commits (valid Enter or blur, release of a scrub, an arrow step, a discrete choice). Raised before onValueChange. The handler may return false to reject: the part keeps the draft, marks that field invalid until the next edit, Escape or a new value prop, shows the value prop again for a discrete control, and does not raise onValueChange.

onDraftChange.payload: { field: 'gap' | 'paddingTop' | 'paddingRight' | 'paddingBottom' | 'paddingLeft'; text: string; value: number | null; error: 'empty' | 'syntax' | 'range' | null; dirty: boolean }
onDraftChange.when: a numeric field text changes (NumberField contract: error empty, syntax or range, dirty while it differs from the committed value). field names the field.

onPreviewChange.when: commitMode release only: a scrub or drag gesture is in progress, with the value being previewed (not a commit); null when it ends or Escape cancels it. onValueChange follows once on release. Only gap and the padding fields scrub; the pad, the segments, the select, the switches and the track list are discrete.

onValueChange.when: any control changes the layout; the payload is the whole value

keyboard.Tab: flow, pad, gap, distribution, wrap, padding mode, padding fields, clip, track list in reading order
keyboard.ArrowDown / ArrowUp (open choice list): move focus to the next / previous option (wraps)
keyboard.Escape: closes an open choice list

notes: Flow items need aria-labels (Free, Horizontal, Vertical, Grid); the padding mode items are text.
The preview is decorative (aria-hidden).
Every composed control keeps its own accessible name; the section needs a heading from InspectorSection.

keyboard.ArrowUp: focus the same weekday in the previous week
keyboard.ArrowDown: focus the same weekday in the next week
keyboard.Home: focus the first day of the week
keyboard.End: focus the last day of the week
keyboard.Enter / Space on the title: open the month/year picker with focus on the shown month
keyboard.ArrowUp / ArrowDown in the picker: previous / next month or year, applied at once (the grid follows)
keyboard.PageUp / PageDown in the picker: five months or years back / forward
keyboard.Tab in the picker: move between the month and year columns
keyboard.Enter / Space / Escape in the picker: close it and return focus to the title

notes: role="grid" labelled by the title; one tab stop (roving tabindex) on the selected day, else today, else the first day. Arrow keys move focus; the grid scrolls nothing.

The title is aria-live="polite" so month changes are announced. It sits in a button that opens the month/year picker (Popover: role="dialog", aria-label “Choose month and year”); the two columns are listboxes with roving tabindex and aria-selected options.
Each day has an accessible name with the full date (“Thursday, October 8, 2026”) and aria-selected; today also has aria-current="date". The visible number alone is not the name.

Selected endpoints use accent.on on accent.solid; in-range days are selection.on on selection.fill (the inverted selection); the state is also in aria-selected. Today is the grey fill and aria-current="date".
Inside a DatePicker the panel is role="dialog" with aria-label “Choose dates”; the calendar itself adds no role to its root.

many similar items should read as rows rather than tiles
the card is an add or empty placeholder with next steps

keyboard.ArrowLeft / ArrowUp: single: choose the previous item (wraps) and move focus to it
keyboard.Space / Enter: choose (single) or toggle (multiple) the focused item

code-diff.intent: Let a person review code the agent wrote as a unified diff with line numbers and Accept or Reject.

the change is visual and best judged as before and after renderings

code-realization.name: CodeRealization
code-realization.intent: Follow the agent turning a design into code: phase progress, the files it will write, what it could not do, and the download.

consider.when: people export assets or tokens directly, without an agent writing code
people need to read the actual lines of one file
the steps are a general sequence with no files or download

guidance: File rows are summaries; open the lines of a file in a CodeDiff next to it.
Give limits their own warning file row so what could not be realized is not missed.

shadow.description: Elevation of the current step plate. Default 1; none flattens it (the surface fill still marks it).

parts.description: One step: inline flex, 24px tall, 6px gap, label text medium, no fill. Done: secondary label. Todo: tertiary label. Current: a raised plate (surface.base, shadow 1, md radius, 8px inline padding) with the primary label. aria-current="step" on the current one.

onTargetClick.when: the target chooser is activated, to open the consumer's listbox

keyboard.Tab: moves through the target chooser and Download (phases and files are not focusable)

notes: No built-in English: phasesLabel, filesLabel, targetLabel, downloadLabel, phaseStatusLabels and the file addedLabel / removedLabel are supplied by the consumer. The fixture and the example pass "Progress", "Files", t => `Realization target: ${t}`, "Download zip", { done: ", done", now: ", current" }, " added" and " removed", so the baseline stays identical.

The phases are an ordered list; the current one has aria-current="step", and each step's state is also in text for assistive technology ("Requested, done", "Reviewing, current"). Color and the check glyph are redundant.
File rows read as "PricingCard.tsx, 48 added, 6 removed"; the colors of the counts are redundant with the signs and the words.
The warning row is a Badge with text ("2 limits") plus the warning glyph.
The agent orb is the agent's light (P2) on the current phase only; it is decorative and stops under reduced motion (P8).

color-picker.name: ColorPicker
color-picker.intent: Pick one paint in a popover: a saturation and brightness plane, hue and alpha, eyedropper, hex fields and page swatches.

consider.when: a token colour is tuned precisely, channel by channel
the paint is a gradient rather than a flat colour

guidance: Open it from a ColorWell or PaintWell; inside a popover of your own use embedded so the chrome does not stack.
Use commitMode "release" so one drag on the plane or a slider is one undo step.
color-picker.import: import { ColorPicker, ColorPickerPopover, ColorPickerPlane, ColorPickerSwatches } from '@caustic/react';

tone.description: Rest colour of the paint-type glyphs: neutral = text.tertiary, a hue = its text 11. Hover (text.primary on neutral.hover) and the checked type (the selected inversion) are the same in every tone.

variant.description: The picker surface. solid (default for the dialog) = the thick floating material with its elevation; outline = surface.base with a border.default inset hairline; soft = neutral.track; ghost = no surface (the default when embedded).

radius.description: Corner radius token of the dialog. Default 2xl.

shadow.description: Elevation: on the solid material it sets the material shadow (glass-shadow), on the other variants the elevation shadow. Default 4 (the dialog); none flattens it.

size.description: Body padding and gaps: xs 6px, sm 8px, md 10px, lg 12px (an embedded picker keeps no body padding, only the gaps). The width stays size-color-picker-w (268px; embedded: the column): the scale has no other picker widths.

invalid.description: K2e: fields the owner marks invalid (a rejected commit, a bound value that needs explicit local intent). Sets aria-invalid="true", data-invalid and the danger edge on that field only; its draft and value stay. Independent of a rejection the part tracks itself through onFieldCommit returning false.

describedBy.description: K2e: id of the owner error or hint text per field (aria-describedby on the field input).

embedded.description: K2e inline variant: renders the picker content in the normal flow of an owner surface instead of as a floating dialog. No glass, radius, shadow or fixed width (it fills its container), role group labelled labels.dialog instead of dialog, no header (tabs and close), no focus move on mount and no Escape handling. Default false.

sections.description: K2e: which blocks render. Default for the dialog: all but hsv; default when embedded: plane, hue, alpha, fields. hsv adds three NumberFields H, S and V (0 to 360, 0 to 100, 0 to 100) under the hex row (labels.hsv). Order is fixed.

commitMode.description: live (default): the behavior before K2d. release: the NumberField value model for every numeric field of this part, and one commit per continuous gesture. The plane, hue and alpha sliders preview while dragging and commit on release; the hex and alpha fields are drafts; a swatch, a paint type, a tab and the eyedropper commit at once.

mixed.description: Fields whose selection values differ; each shows labels.mixed in place of a value (text fields as placeholder, toggles with aria-pressed "mixed", selects as the select value) and never a substituted first value. A mixed plane draws no thumb; mixed hex and alpha show the mixed text; the preview shows the hatch of a mixed ColorWell.

reserved.description: Fields that are being written or held by another window: read-only, aria-busy="true", data-reserved, focus and draft kept, no event while reserved.

disabled.description: true disables every control; a record disables the named parts (for example paintType while the paint type cannot change).

labels.type: { dialog: string; tabsGroup: string; tabs: Record<'custom' | 'tokens', string>; close: string; typesGroup: string; types: Record<'solid' | 'linear' | 'radial' | 'angular' | 'diamond' | 'image', string>; plane: string; planeValueText: (saturation: number, brightness: number) => string; eyedropper: string; hue: string; alpha: string; format: string; hex: string; alphaField: string; swatchesTitle: string; addSwatch: string; hsv?: { h: string; s: string; v: string; hShort: string; sShort: string; vShort: string }; mixed: string }
labels.description: Every text and accessible name of the part and of its parts (the ColorPicker.Plane label and valueText); no English default. The specimen values: "Color picker", Custom, Tokens, Close, Solid, Linear, Radial, Angular, Diamond, Image, "Saturation and brightness", Eyedropper, Hue, Alpha, Hex, "On this page", "Add swatch", Mixed. The swatch labels already come from swatches[].label.

value.type: { h: number; s: number; v: number; a: number } | null
value.description: Controlled color: hue 0–360, saturation and brightness 0–1, alpha 0–1. null is a mixed selection (no thumb, mixed hex and alpha, hatched preview); the first change sets a value for the whole selection.

defaultValue.type: { h: number; s: number; v: number; a: number }
defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial color (#E2763F in the specimen).

paintType.description: Selected paint type. When omitted no type is selected (the plain render); the example passes "solid".

The plane height stays size-color-plane-h.

No glass, radius, shadow or fixed width (it fills its container), role group labelled labels.dialog instead of dialog, no header (tabs and close), no focus move on mount and no Escape handling. Default false.

Sets aria-invalid="true", data-invalid and the danger edge on that field only; its draft and value stay. Independent of a rejection the part tracks itself through onFieldCommit returning false.

mixed.description: Fields whose selection values differ; each shows labels.mixed in place of a value (text fields as placeholder, toggles with aria-pressed "mixed", selects as the select value) and never a substituted first value. commitMode.description: live (default): the behavior before K2d. release: the NumberField value model for every numeric field of this part, and one commit per continuous gesture. Default false.

invalid.description: K2e: fields the owner marks invalid (a rejected commit, a bound value that needs explicit local intent). parts.name: ColorPickerPlane
parts.description: ColorPicker.Plane (also exported as ColorPickerPlane): a 2D slider drawn from the current hue, white to the pure hue from left to right with a transparent-to-black layer from top to bottom. Full width of its column, 150px high, xl radius, a 1px inset swatch.edge edge, overflow hidden, crosshair cursor, touch-action none. Paints --plane-color (hsl(hue 100% 50%)) to the right over media.on, and media.shade from the bottom. The hue, the picked colour and the thumb position are data (custom properties). In the picker it carries data-mixed (the thumb is hidden until focused) and the reserved attributes of the plane field.

parts.name: ColorPickerSwatches
parts.description: ColorPicker.Swatches (also exported as ColorPickerSwatches) with 9 columns: a radio group of equal square swatches on a grid (repeat(columns, 1fr)), 6px gap. The colours are data: each item brings its CSS colour and accessible name; whether it is a token is a flag.

onFieldFocus.when: K2e: focus enters a field, or a scrub or drag starts on its label (NumberField onScrubStart). The owner acquires that field reservation here. Not raised while the field is reserved or disabled.

onFieldBlur.when: K2e: focus leaves a field after its commit decision. dirty is true while an invalid or uncommitted draft stays in it, so the owner keeps the reservation and the selection guard.

onFieldCommit.payload: { field: 'plane'; value: { s: number; v: number } } | { field: 'hue' | 'alpha'; value: number } | { field: 'hex'; value: string } | { field: 'alphaField' | 'hsvH' | 'hsvS' | 'hsvV'; value: number } | { field: 'paintType'; value: string } | { field: 'swatches'; value: string }
onFieldCommit.when: K2e: exactly one field commits (valid Enter or blur, release of a scrub, an arrow step, a discrete choice). Raised before onValueChange. The handler may return false to reject: the part keeps the draft, marks that field invalid until the next edit, Escape or a new value prop, shows the value prop again for a discrete control, and does not raise onValueChange.

onDraftChange.payload: { field: 'hex' | 'alphaField'; text: string; value: number | null; error: 'empty' | 'syntax' | 'range' | null; dirty: boolean }
onDraftChange.when: a numeric field text changes (NumberField contract: error empty, syntax or range, dirty while it differs from the committed value). field names the field. value is the uppercase digits (string) for hex.

onPreviewChange.payload: { h: number; s: number; v: number; a: number } | null
onPreviewChange.when: commitMode release only: a scrub or drag gesture is in progress, with the value being previewed (not a commit); null when it ends or Escape cancels it. onValueChange follows once on release. Plane, hue and alpha drags and the eyedropper pick.

onValueChange.payload: { h: number; s: number; v: number; a: number }
onValueChange.when: the plane, a slider, the hex field, the alpha field, a swatch or the eyedropper changes the color

onClose.when: the close button is pressed or Escape

keyboard.Escape: close
keyboard.Tab: tabs, close, paint types, plane thumb, eyedropper, hue, alpha, format, hex, alpha field, add, swatches (roving tabindex: the picked swatch, then out)
keyboard.Arrow keys: on the types row: previous / next type; on the plane thumb: Right / Left saturation ±1 %, Up / Down brightness ±1 % (Shift: 10 %), Home / End saturation 0 / 100 %; on the swatches: previous / next swatch, picking it; on the sliders: see Slider

notes: The popover has aria-label "Color picker" and moves focus to the first control when it opens; Escape returns it to the ColorWell.
Paint types are a radio group (arrow keys); each button is labelled by its name because the glyph is decorative.
The plane and sliders have their own slider semantics; the hex and alpha fields repeat the value as text.
The plane thumb is role="slider" with aria-label "Saturation and brightness" and aria-valuetext like "Saturation 95 %, brightness 89 %".

Every swatch needs an aria-label with the colour or token name; the token dot is not announced, so token labels should say it ("accent token"). Swatches are about 22px at 9 columns, just under 24px; the 6px gaps keep them apart. The check is decorative; aria-checked carries the state.

color-tile.name: ColorTile
color-tile.intent: Show a colour token as a swatch with its value and its contrast against white and black.

consider.when: people should pick or edit the colour
the contrast story needs more than white and black

guidance: Colours are runtime data passed as props, never as class names; tiles read best in a grid.

variant.description: Tile emphasis. ghost (default) = no tile box, the swatch is the card and the text sits under it; outline = boxed, surface.base with the 1px inset hairline; soft = neutral.track body (or the tone tint), no edge; solid = surface.raised, no edge.

shadow.description: Elevation: of the swatch when ghost (default), of the tile when boxed. Default none (one depth cue, the hairline).

consider.when: showing a palette colour with its name and value
the row also needs the hex digits and alpha

combobox.name: Combobox
combobox.intent: Choose from a long list by typing to filter it, inline in a form or from a compact trigger.

consider.when: there are about seven options or fewer and typing adds nothing
the user enters several free values rather than one from a list
the list holds commands to run, not a value to keep

guidance: popup mode keeps the field compact for inspector rows and toolbars; inline mode suits forms.
Options can carry a leading swatch, icon or tile, a description and a badge before you reach for renderOption.
combobox.import: import { Combobox, ComboboxOption, ComboboxRow, ComboboxTile } from '@caustic/react';

The input needs an accessible name; the placeholder is not a label.
The usage ring is role="img" with the percentage in its label; it is not the only signal when it nears the limit (the product adds text).

context-analytics.name: ContextAnalytics
context-analytics.intent: Show how much of the model context window a session uses, per round and by what fills it.

consider.when: one usage number with a trend is enough
a single bar of how full the window is will do

guidance: It has no surface of its own; place it in a Card, a popover or a panel section.
The chart always has 12 round columns; pad earlier sessions with empty rounds.

variant.description: The round columns. soft (default) = neutral.track; solid = neutral.graphic; outline = a 1px neutral.border hairline, no fill; ghost = no column, only the output share. The selected ring replaces the hairline.

radius.description: Corner radius token of the round columns (the output share inherits it). Default sm.

shadow.description: Elevation of the figure. Default none.

rounds.description: Per round: share of the window used (0–100) and the part of it that was output (0–100 of the window; drawn as a share of the column). Fixed 12 columns; missing rounds render as the 4% stub.

selectedRound.description: Index of the selected round (ring). Controlled.

parts.description: One round: a column whose height is the share of the window used by that round (minimum 4%). Neutral fill, rounded top. A button when selectable.

onSelectedRoundChange.when: a round column is chosen by pointer or keyboard

keyboard.Tab: moves to the selected round, then out; rounds are a roving group
keyboard.ArrowLeft: selects the previous round with data
keyboard.ArrowRight: selects the next round with data
keyboard.End: selects the last round with data

notes: The summary row and the legend state the numbers in text; the bars are not the only carrier. The composition bar has role="img" with a label listing each part and its share.

Each selectable round is a button (visually the column) with an aria-label "Round N, X% of window" and aria-pressed; stubs are aria-hidden. The 24px minimum hit is met by padding the button, not by the column box.
Series are told apart by the legend text, not by color alone. Chart tokens must reach 3:1 against surface.base and bg.app (non-text).
Data marks use the chart family only (chart.1 for the output share and the scene series, neutral.track for the column and Free); accent is not used for data. The spectrum is never used here.

contrast-insight.name: ContrastInsight
contrast-insight.intent: Explain the contrast of a selected element: the ratio, WCAG levels met, a sample, and a fix suggestion when it falls short.

consider.when: reporting many checks across a design rather than one colour pair

guidance: You compute the ratio and pass the sample colours; the component only presents them.

radius.description: Corner radius token of the readout and suggestion cards. Default xl.

variant.description: The readout card. outline (default) = surface.base with the subtle inset hairline; soft = neutral.track (or the tone tint), no edge; solid = surface.raised, no edge; ghost = no fill or edge. The suggestion card keeps its agent rim.

result.description: Result of a level badge (the level slot). warning = reached only for large text (3 : 1 to 4.5 : 1).

parts.name: ContrastInsightLevel
parts.description: One level badge ("AA", "AA large", "AAA"): inline flex, 22px, 8px inline padding, 4px gap, sm radius, micro text (11px semibold). A check glyph on a pass, a triangle on a warning (reached only for large text), a cross on a fail (12px, heavy stroke), so the result is not only color. A visually hidden word follows ("passes" / "passes for large text only" / "fails").

keyboard.Tab: moves through Apply and Compare (and the controls of the note, if any)

notes: The ratio is text ("4.62 : 1"); the levels state the result in text: "AA passes", "AA large passes for large text only", "AAA fails". The check and cross glyphs and the tints are redundant.
The sample is decorative and aria-hidden; give the card a text description of the pair elsewhere ("Button label on brand fill").
The suggestion sentence names the token and the resulting ratio, so Apply is understandable without the sample.
The agent rim on the suggestion card marks it as the agent's proposal (P2); the text says so too.
The note is an Alert with role="status".

corner-radius.name: CornerRadius
corner-radius.intent: Edit the corner radius of a shape: one value, corner smoothing, and four independent corners behind a toggle.

consider.when: a single radius value is all that is needed

guidance: Typing the main radius sets all four corners; mark it mixed while the corners differ.

tone.description: Common prop. Colour family of the preview shape (the emphasis of the part): outline draws the 1.5px ring in the tone graphic, solid and soft fill the shape, ghost draws a 1px tone border.

variant.description: Common prop. Emphasis of the preview shape. outline = today: surface.base with a 1.5px ring (text.primary for neutral, the tone graphic otherwise). solid = tone solid fill (ink for neutral), no ring. soft = tone soft fill (neutral.track), no ring. ghost = no fill, a 1px tone border ring.

radius.description: Common prop. Corner radius of the root. Unset = none (the root has no box of its own).

shadow.description: Common prop. Elevation of the root. Unset = none.

size.description: Common prop. Stack gap of the root: xs 8, sm 12, md 14 (today), lg 16. The NumberFields and the toggle keep their own control size (smallest sensible effect for a composition).

invalid.description: K2e: fields the owner marks invalid (a rejected commit, a bound value that needs explicit local intent). Sets aria-invalid="true", data-invalid and the danger edge on that field only; its draft and value stay. Independent of a rejection the part tracks itself through onFieldCommit returning false.

describedBy.description: K2e: id of the owner error or hint text per field (aria-describedby on the field input).

limits.type: Partial<Record<'radius' | 'smoothing' | 'tl' | 'tr' | 'bl' | 'br', { min?: number | undefined; max?: number | undefined; step?: number | undefined }>>
limits.description: K2e: per-field range and step from the owner (a size is 0 or more, letter spacing steps 0.1). Defaults are the specimen values. A typed value outside the range is a range draft error in release mode and is clamped in live mode.

children.description: K2e: extra owner rows appended after the corner grid (polygon points, star inner radius, arcs), spaced by the same gap (a details popover trigger, size limits, points, arcs, a transform matrix). They are outside every field contract and render nothing by default.

value.type: { radius: number; smoothing: number; corners: { tl: number; tr: number; bl: number; br: number } }
value.description: Controlled value. radius is the all-corners value; corners holds the four individual values.

defaultValue.type: { radius: number; smoothing: number; corners: { tl: number; tr: number; bl: number; br: number } }
defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial value; the default is the specimen state.

defaultIndependent.description: Uncontrolled initial state. The specimen starts with true.

disabled.description: true disables every control; a record disables the named fields.

onFieldFocus.when: K2e: focus enters a field, or a scrub or drag starts on its label (NumberField onScrubStart). The owner acquires that field reservation here. Not raised while the field is reserved or disabled.

onFieldBlur.when: K2e: focus leaves a field after its commit decision. dirty is true while an invalid or uncommitted draft stays in it, so the owner keeps the reservation and the selection guard.

onFieldCommit.payload: { field: 'radius' | 'smoothing' | 'tl' | 'tr' | 'bl' | 'br'; value: number } | { field: 'independent'; value: boolean }
onFieldCommit.when: K2e: exactly one field commits (valid Enter or blur, release of a scrub, an arrow step, a discrete choice). Raised before onValueChange. The handler may return false to reject: the part keeps the draft, marks that field invalid until the next edit, Escape or a new value prop, shows the value prop again for a discrete control, and does not raise onValueChange.

onDraftChange.payload: { field: 'radius' | 'smoothing' | 'tl' | 'tr' | 'bl' | 'br'; text: string; value: number | null; error: 'empty' | 'syntax' | 'range' | null; dirty: boolean }
onDraftChange.when: a numeric field text changes (NumberField contract: error empty, syntax or range, dirty while it differs from the committed value). field names the field.

onPreviewChange.payload: { radius: number; smoothing: number; corners: { tl: number; tr: number; bl: number; br: number } } | null
onPreviewChange.when: commitMode release only: a scrub or drag gesture is in progress, with the value being previewed (not a commit); null when it ends or Escape cancels it. onValueChange follows once on release. The preview stage follows it, so the shape is seen while scrubbing.

onValueChange.payload: { radius: number; smoothing: number; corners: { tl: number; tr: number; bl: number; br: number } }
onValueChange.when: any field commits; changing radius sets all four corners to the same value

keyboard.Tab: radius, smoothing, independent, then the four corner fields in DOM order

notes: Each field has an aria-label; the glyphs are aria-hidden.
The corner grid is added to the tab order only while shown.

date-picker.name: DatePicker
date-picker.intent: Choose a date or a date range in a form, from a field that opens a calendar panel.

consider.when: the month grid should stay open on the page or in a panel

guidance: Values are ISO date strings; the trigger formats them in English, as in Oct 8 – Oct 14, 2026.
In range mode the panel stays open between the start and the end; a shortcut sets both at once.

variant.description: Common prop. Forwarded to the PickerTrigger. outline = today: the field look (translucent fill, border.default hairline). solid, soft and ghost as PickerTrigger defines them.

radius.description: Common prop. Forwarded to the PickerTrigger: corner radius of the trigger. Unset = xl.

shadow.description: Common prop. Forwarded to the PickerTrigger: elevation of the trigger. Unset = none.

value.description: Controlled value: ISO date (single) or { from, to } (range).

placeholder.description: Shown in the trigger until a value exists.

disabled.description: Disables the trigger.

invalid.description: Danger trigger edge; also taken from an enclosing Field with an error.

inline.description: Render the Calendar in place under the trigger, open, without portal or positioning. For docs and specimens.

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.intent: Ask for a decision, a short input or a form on top of the page, or hold a secondary task at an edge.

consider.when: the task belongs at the right or bottom edge with the page still in view
a few compact controls belong next to the element that opened them
the message needs no decision and can stay on the page

guidance: A destructive confirm (kind="alert") says in its description how to undo.
The compact form fits a two-line decision; pass title for a form with a header, body and several actions.
dialog.import: import { Dialog, DialogAction, DialogBody, DialogClose, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@caustic/react';

placement.description: Where the surface sits. right and bottom are the sheets (Sheet is the named preset).

kind.description: Dialog or alert dialog.

tone.description: Common prop. Hue of the surface: a hue draws a 1px rim (solid, outline, ghost) or tints the material (soft).

variant.description: Common prop. solid = thick material; soft = the tone soft fill; outline = thick material with a 1px rim; ghost = no elevation.

radius.description: Common prop. Corner radius. Unset = panel (the placement radius).

shadow.description: Common prop. Elevation of the glass. Unset = 5 (ghost: none).

size.description: Common prop. Centre: the width step. Compact xs 280 (popover-md) with the compact inset and an 8px gap, sm 320; sectioned xs 320, sm 380 (modal-sm, the alert width); md 480, lg 640 for both. Edge: steps the band padding (xs 12, sm 14, md 16, lg 20 inline), the body gap and the title; lg also takes the sm close button.

dividers.description: Hairlines (border.subtle) under the header and above the footer of the sectioned frame. Off by default (owner 2026-10-28): the bands are separated by space only. On, the body takes its full top padding (edge md 16px, centre 16px). No effect on the compact frame.

defaultOpen.description: Uncontrolled initial state. Inline defaults to open.

modal.description: Trap focus and hide the page from assistive tech (kind dialog).

trigger.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with asChild).

title.description: Header title. Given, the dialog renders the sectioned frame: DialogHeader (icon tile, title, description, close), DialogBody around the children and DialogFooter around footer.

icon.description: Icon shown in the tile before the title: neutral track and secondary text for kind="dialog", danger soft for kind="alert".

footer.description: Footer content (buttons, an optional flex-1 spacer), rendered in DialogFooter.

children.description: Body content with title; the parts of a custom layout without it.

inline.description: Render in place, open, without portal or overlay (docs, specimens, embedded flows). Centre sits in the flow; edge placements sit absolutely inside the nearest positioned ancestor with the same edge insets.

showClose.description: Close button (top-right in the compact frame, at the end of the header in the sectioned frame).

closeLabel.description: aria-label of the close button (e.g. "Close"). Required whenever showClose is true; no built-in default. Optional in the type only because it is unused when showClose is false.

children.description: Body content with title; the parts of a custom layout without it.

consider.when: timing several layers or keyframes over time

guidance: It is about 480px tall and never scrolls itself; put it in a scrolling container or turn the preview off.

variant.description: Common prop. shadow.description: Common prop. Elevation of the root. Unset = none.

size.description: Common prop. Stack gap of the root: xs 8, sm 12, md 14 (today), lg 16. The graph, the chips and the field keep their own size (smallest sensible effect for a composition).

invalid.description: K2e: fields the owner marks invalid (a rejected commit, a bound value that needs explicit local intent). describedBy.description: K2e: id of the owner error or hint text per field (aria-describedby on the field input).

limits.type: Partial<Record<'duration', { min?: number | undefined; max?: number | undefined; step?: number | undefined }>>

preview.description: K2e: false removes the motion preview stage (56px plus its 14px gap) for an owner that previews the motion itself or has little height. The graph, presets, css text and duration stay.

empty-state.name: EmptyState
empty-state.intent: What a region shows when it has nothing yet or no results: why it is empty and what to do next.

consider.when: the content is on its way and only needs a loading shape
the region has content but something about it needs a notice

guidance: Say why it is empty, then give the next step; keep to one primary action.
variant="agent" is the blank-canvas opener: an orb and a serif prompt asking what to design.

tone.description: Common prop. Colour family of the icon tile (the one emphasis of the region).

variant.description: Common prop, extended with two presets. dashed (default) = mark icon, voice off, surface dashed; agent = mark orb, voice on, surface grid. solid / soft / outline / ghost = the dashed preset with that tile emphasis (soft = dashed). An explicit mark, voice or surface wins over the preset.

mark.description: What sits above the title: 'icon' (the tile with icon), 'orb' (the agent orb), an element (drawn in the media row, like media) or null (nothing). Unset follows the preset.

voice.description: The agent voice: serif title (voice-xl at md and lg, voice at sm, voice-sm at xs), description in ui-sm text.tertiary at 34ch, and the agent Button first among action objects. Unset follows the preset (agent: on).

surface.description: Background of the region. Unset follows the preset (agent: grid).

radius.description: Common prop. Corner radius of the region (the dashed outline follows it). Unset = 2xl (xl on the grid surface).

keyboard.ArrowRight: domain row: move focus to the next domain (wraps)
keyboard.ArrowLeft: domain row: move focus to the previous domain (wraps)
keyboard.Home: domain row: focus the first domain
keyboard.End: domain row: focus the last domain
keyboard.Enter / Space: activate the focused domain, the add button or a family segment
keyboard.Tab: the domain row is one tab stop (roving tabindex); the family switch, the host's controls and the add button are separate stops

notes: No built-in English: label, familyLabel, domainsLabel, searchLabel, searchPlaceholder, addLabel, and every family and domain label are supplied by the consumer. The fixture and the examples pass the studio strings listed in usage.

The capsule is role="group" with a name; the family switch is the SegmentedControl radio group; the domain row is role="toolbar" with a name. Nested toolbars are avoided: the capsule itself is not a toolbar.
A domain button is named by its visible label (the icon is aria-hidden) and exposes aria-pressed; the filled look is not the only signal. Exactly one domain is pressed, or none when domain is "".

Roving tabindex on the domain row: the pressed domain (else the first) has tabindex 0, the others -1; arrows, Home and End move focus. The studio today leaves every domain button tabbable; one tab stop is the toolbar pattern and is part of this spec.

The compact picker is the Combobox: input role combobox with aria-activedescendant, listbox named by searchLabel, results announced by the consumer's resultsLabel (the toolbar passes none; the open list is the signal).

gradient-editor.name: GradientEditor
gradient-editor.intent: Edit a gradient on its preview: drag handles and stops, switch linear, radial or angular, set the angle, tune each stop.

consider.when: the paint is a single flat colour

guidance: Use commitMode "release" so a drag on the preview, strip or dial is one undo step.

tone.description: Common prop. Colour family of the preview frame (the gradient itself is data and keeps its colours).

variant.description: Common prop. Emphasis of the preview frame. outline = today: a 1px swatch.edge inset frame (a tone takes its border). solid = a 2px graphic frame (neutral.graphic or the tone graphic). soft = the hairline plus a 2px soft halo outside (neutral.track or the tone soft). ghost = no frame (the tone has nothing to colour).

radius.description: Common prop. Corner radius of the root. Unset = none (the root has no box of its own).

shadow.description: Common prop. Elevation of the root. Unset = none.

size.description: Common prop. Gap between the canvas column and the stop list: xs 8, sm 12, md 16 (today), lg 20. The controls keep their own size (smallest sensible effect for a composition).

invalid.description: K2e: fields the owner marks invalid (a rejected commit, a bound value that needs explicit local intent). Sets aria-invalid="true", data-invalid and the danger edge on that field only; its draft and value stay. Independent of a rejection the part tracks itself through onFieldCommit returning false.

describedBy.description: K2e: id of the owner error or hint text per field (aria-describedby on the field input).

limits.type: Partial<Record<'angle' | 'stopPosition' | 'startX' | 'startY' | 'endX' | 'endY', { min?: number | undefined; max?: number | undefined; step?: number | undefined }>>
limits.description: K2e: per-field range and step from the owner (a size is 0 or more, letter spacing steps 0.1). Defaults are the specimen values. A typed value outside the range is a range draft error in release mode and is clamped in live mode.

showTypeSwitch.description: K2e: false hides the Linear / Radial / Angular switch. Axiom chooses the paint type in a select above the editor, which also offers Diamond.

reorderStops.description: K2e: true re-sorts the stops by position after an edit (the specimen). false keeps their order and clamps a stop position between its neighbors, which is how Axiom edits (the stop index is the identity of the stop).

children.description: K2e: extra owner rows appended at the end of the stops column, after Start & end (the transform matrix accordion), spaced by the same gap (a details popover trigger, size limits, points, arcs, a transform matrix). parts.name: GradientEditorStrip
parts.description: GradientEditor.Strip (also exported as GradientEditorStrip) with the same stops: the colour-stop track, always a left-to-right linear ramp whatever the type. Positioned container 26px high, margin 10px 9px 18px in the editor (6px on its own; 18px below for the handles), so the 18px handles at 0 % and 100 % stay inside; sm radius, touch-action none. Pressing the bar adds a stop; dragging a handle moves one. In the editor it carries data-mixed and the reserved attributes of stopPosition.

onFieldFocus.when: K2e: focus enters a field, or a scrub or drag starts on its label (NumberField onScrubStart). The owner acquires that field reservation here. Not raised while the field is reserved or disabled.

onFieldBlur.when: K2e: focus leaves a field after its commit decision. dirty is true while an invalid or uncommitted draft stays in it, so the owner keeps the reservation and the selection guard.

onFieldCommit.payload: { field: 'angle' | 'startX' | 'startY' | 'endX' | 'endY'; value: number } | { field: 'stopPosition'; index: number; value: number } | { field: 'stopColor'; index: number; value: string } | { field: 'type'; value: 'linear' | 'radial' | 'angular' | 'diamond' } | { field: 'start' | 'end'; value: { x: number; y: number } } | { field: 'stops'; value: { position: number; color: string }[] }
onFieldCommit.when: K2e: exactly one field commits (valid Enter or blur, release of a scrub, an arrow step, a discrete choice). Raised before onValueChange. The handler may return false to reject: the part keeps the draft, marks that field invalid until the next edit, Escape or a new value prop, shows the value prop again for a discrete control, and does not raise onValueChange.

onDraftChange.payload: { field: 'angle' | 'stopPosition' | 'startX' | 'startY' | 'endX' | 'endY'; text: string; value: number | null; error: 'empty' | 'syntax' | 'range' | null; dirty: boolean }
onDraftChange.when: a numeric field text changes (NumberField contract: error empty, syntax or range, dirty while it differs from the committed value). field names the field. For a stop row the payload also carries index. The hex field draft of a stop uses field stopColor with the uppercase digits as value (string).

onPreviewChange.when: commitMode release only: a scrub or drag gesture is in progress, with the value being previewed (not a commit); null when it ends or Escape cancels it. onValueChange follows once on release. Handle, dot, strip and dial drags.

onValueChange.when: a handle, a dot, the strip, the type switch, the angle controls, a stop row or a Start & end field changes the gradient

onSelectedChange.when: a stop is selected by dot, strip handle, row or after an add

keyboard.Arrow keys: on a handle: move it 1 % (Shift: 10 %); on a strip stop: move it 1 % along the strip (Shift, PageUp / PageDown: 10 %; Home / End: 0 / 100 %)
keyboard.Tab: handles, strip stops, type, dial, angle field, rotate, flip, add, rows, Start & end fields
keyboard.Enter: on the summary: toggle the Start & end section

notes: Handles are sliders with arrow-key movement and a clear aria-label; their aria-valuetext reads the coordinates ("15 %, 50 %").
The preview is illustrative: every value is also available as a labelled field (angle, positions, hex, start and end), so the pointer is never the only way to edit.
The readout is aria-hidden; the angle field carries the value.
The stop dots are 14px, below the 24px target; the rows and the strip handles are the larger targets.

Each strip handle is role="slider" with aria-label "Stop 1", "Stop 2"…, aria-valuenow = position and aria-valuetext "52 %, #F4C26B". Handles are 18 × 22px, below 24px; the stop rows repeat every stop with fields.

parts.description: One bound property. Grid of 1fr / auto with a 6px row and column gap (the title line has room above the selector, also next to the mixed badge), 8px padding, lg radius, solid base surface with a subtle hairline edge. aria-label = the property name (a string property, or the selectorLabel stem).

Unbind is an IconButton xs: it needs aria-label "Unbind" (with the property for several rows: "Unbind Fill").

layer-tree.name: LayerTree
layer-tree.intent: The layers panel: a keyboard tree of canvas objects with selection, visibility, lock and drag to reorder.

consider.when: the items are flat with no nesting
the hierarchy is an agent run, not objects people edit

guidance: Render only rows whose ancestors are expanded; filtering is yours, the tree shows what it is given.
The tree reports moves, hides and locks through events; apply them to your data.

tone.description: Colour of the drop line and the drop-inside row.

variant.description: Emphasis of the drop-inside row.

radius.description: Row radius (radius token); unset keeps md.

shadow.description: Tree elevation (elevation token); unset is flat.

size.description: Row and ghost height and type: 24 / ui-xs · 26 / ui-sm · 28 / ui-dense (today) · 32 / ui. Glyphs stay 14px.

announce.description: Builds the text of the polite live region from a structured event, so it can be translated and pluralized. LayerTreeAnnouncement = { type: "selected" | "expanded" | "collapsed" | "hid" | "showed" | "locked" | "unlocked"; names: string[] } | { type: "moved"; names: string[]; position: "before" | "after" | "inside"; target: string } | { type: "cancelled" }. names are the layer names (the id when a label is not a string) in tree order; names.length is the count, so the consumer chooses between "Selected Cards" and "3 layers selected". No built-in default.

visibilityLabel.description: Builds the aria-label of the visibility toggle from the layer name and its current state (hidden = the layer is hidden now, so the action is "Show"). Required whenever onVisibilityChange is given; no built-in default.

lockLabel.description: Builds the aria-label of the lock toggle from the layer name and its current state (locked = the layer is locked now, so the action is "Unlock"). Required whenever onLockChange is given; no built-in default.

stateLabels.type: { hidden: string; locked: string; agent: string }
stateLabels.description: Words of the visually hidden description that follows the layer name, joined with ", " (e.g. "hidden", "locked", "edited by the agent"). Required whenever a row can be invisible, locked or agent-marked; no built-in default.

value.description: Controlled selection: the ids of the selected layers. Every selected row shows the check; the last id is the primary selection (it reads text.primary; the others text.secondary).

expanded.description: Controlled set of expanded row ids.

defaultExpanded.description: Uncontrolled initial expanded ids. Defaults to the rows that have open set.

dragLabel.description: Name of the layer being dragged; renders the ghost. Normally set internally during a drag; also the state hook for fixtures.

itemId.description: LayerTreeItem prop. Stable identity (selection, expansion, moves); rendered as data-item-id.

depth.description: LayerTreeItem prop. Zero-based nesting depth; aria-level is depth + 1.

label.description: LayerTreeItem prop. The layer name.

expandable.description: LayerTreeItem prop. The layer has children (rendered or not): shows a twisty and aria-expanded.

open.description: LayerTreeItem prop. State hook for fixtures; normally derived from the tree-level expanded set. Rendered as aria-expanded.

selected.description: LayerTreeItem prop. State hook for fixtures; normally derived from the tree-level selection. Rendered as aria-selected and the selected look (neutral.pressed and the check).

secondary.description: LayerTreeItem prop. The row is selected but is not the primary selection (neutral.pressed with the check; text.secondary instead of text.primary).

invisible.description: LayerTreeItem prop. The layer is hidden on the canvas: name and glyphs go disabled and the EyeOff toggle is always shown.

No built-in default.

Selection never takes the tone: selected rows take neutral.pressed in every tone.

variant.description: Emphasis of the drop-inside row (common prop). soft = soft 3 fill with a 1px dashed border-strong outline (default; owner 2026-10-27: the solid black frame read heavy, a dashed target reads temporary); solid = solid 9 fill with the on text; outline = the 1.5px solid edge alone; ghost = tint 2 fill.

radius.description: Corner radius token (common prop). The tree is frameless, so the rows take it (hover, selection and drop shapes). Unset keeps md.

shadow.description: Elevation of the tree (common prop). Unset = flat (the tree sits on the panel).

onValueChange.when: the selection changes by click, Space / Enter, Shift / Ctrl / Cmd selection or select all. The array is in selection order; the last id is the primary.

onExpandedChange.when: a row is expanded or collapsed (twisty, ArrowLeft / ArrowRight, asterisk). Payload is the full expanded set.

onMove.when: selected layers are dropped (pointer) or moved (Alt + arrows). The consumer applies the move; not called for a drop in place or a cancel.

onVisibilityChange.when: the visibility toggle or its shortcut is used.

onLockChange.when: the lock toggle or its shortcut is used.

keyboard.Tab: enters the tree on the selected row (or the first row) and leaves it; the tree is one tab stop (roving tabindex)
keyboard.ArrowDown / ArrowUp: move focus to the next / previous visible row; selection follows focus when it is a single selection
keyboard.ArrowRight: on a collapsed expandable row: expand it; on an expanded row: move to its first child; on a leaf: nothing
keyboard.ArrowLeft: on an expanded row: collapse it; on a collapsed row or a leaf: move to its parent
keyboard.Home / End: move focus to the first / last visible row
keyboard.Enter / Space: select the focused row only (replacing the selection)
keyboard.Shift + ArrowDown / ArrowUp: extend the selection by one visible row from the anchor
keyboard.Shift + Home / End: select from the anchor to the first / last visible row
keyboard.Ctrl or Cmd + ArrowDown / ArrowUp, then: move focus without changing selection, then toggle the focused row in or out of the selection
keyboard.* (asterisk): expand all siblings of the focused row
keyboard.Mod + Shift + H: toggle visibility of the selected layers (the keyboard route of the visibility toggle)
keyboard.Mod + Shift + L: toggle lock of the selected layers (the keyboard route of the lock toggle)
keyboard.Alt + ArrowUp / ArrowDown: move the selected layers one position up or down among their siblings
keyboard.Alt + ArrowRight / ArrowLeft: nest the selected layers into the previous sibling / move them out to the parent level (the onMove event reports it)
keyboard.Escape: cancels a drag in progress; otherwise clears a multi-selection down to the primary row
keyboard.Printable characters: type-ahead: move focus to the next visible row whose name starts with the typed text

notes: No built-in English: the live-region text (announce), the toggle names (visibilityLabel, lockLabel) and the row description words (stateLabels) are supplied by the consumer. The fixture and the examples pass an announce that reproduces the old sentences ("Selected Cards", "3 layers selected", "Expanded Cards", "Hid Cards", "Locked Cards", "Moved Cards into Frame", "Moved 2 layers before Frame", "Move cancelled"), visibilityLabel (n, h) => `${h ? "Show" : "Hide"} ${n}`, lockLabel (n, l) => `${l ? "Unlock" : "Lock"} ${n}` and stateLabels { hidden: "hidden", locked: "locked", agent: "edited by the agent" }, so the rendered output and the baselines stay identical.

WAI-ARIA tree pattern with a flat row structure: role="tree" > role="treeitem" with aria-level, aria-setsize and aria-posinset instead of nested groups. aria-expanded is present only on expandable rows; leaves have none.

Multi-select tree: aria-multiselectable="true" and aria-selected on every row (true or false). Selection is never only a color: aria-selected carries it, every selected row shows the check, and the primary row reads full-strength text.

Hidden and locked are conveyed in the row accessible name or description ("Background photo, hidden, locked"), not only by the disabled color and the glyphs; the toggles have aria-label "Hide <name>" / "Show <name>" and "Lock <name>" / "Unlock <name>" with aria-pressed.
The toggles are tabIndex -1 inside a treeitem; Mod + Shift + H and Mod + Shift + L are the keyboard equivalents, so nothing is pointer-only. Their hit area is 24px.
Drag and drop is never the only way to move a layer: Alt + arrow keys move and re-parent the selection; the live region announces the result.
The agent mark is decorative; the layer description says the agent edited it.
Focus ring on the focused row is the standard inset focus ring; roving tabindex keeps the tree to one tab stop.

list.name: List
list.intent: Rows in a rounded container for settings, people, media or collections, with selection, reorder and row actions.

consider.when: the rows move between pages in a sidebar
the items have several columns to compare or sort
a long choice set should stay closed until opened
the list floats over the page as actions

guidance: grouped reads as a settings form; opaque is the inspector collection that ends with an add row.
It is an inline surface; floating lists belong to Menu and Select.

parts.name: ListRow
parts.description: One row. Flex, aligned to the center, 12px gap, 14px inline padding. A 1px border.subtle separator is drawn on its top edge (except the first row). Every separator of one list starts at the same inset, 14px + the widest leading element of the list + 12px (14px when no row has one), so a mixed list draws one clean column of hairlines. Interactive rows (with a trigger) fill on hover and press. Selection: data-state checked inverts it (selected). Reorder: grab cursor, data-dragging lifts it, data-follow follows the pointer. Actions: data-actions hover fills on hover; swipe clips the body and the tray. Opaque: grid auto / 1fr / auto, 8px gap, 6 / 12 padding, a full-width 1px border.subtle top edge, hover fill.

parts.name: ListGroup
parts.description: Optional outer wrapper (ListGroup): grid with a 6px gap that stacks an outside heading, one or more lists and a footer note. It contains the root; it is not the surface.

parts.name: ListGroupHeading
parts.description: Caption above a list, outside the surface (ListGroupHeading). Uppercase tertiary caption, 14px inline padding to align with row text.

parts.name: ListGroupFooter
parts.description: Note below a list, outside the surface (ListGroupFooter): footnote text, tertiary, 14px inline padding.

parts.name: ListAddRow
parts.description: ListAddRow: the list item that holds the add button, last in the list.

onClick.when: the row trigger is activated by pointer, Enter or Space (ListRow prop)

onValueChange.when: the selection changes (List prop): single mode reports the chosen value, multiple mode the full new array in row order

onReorder.payload: { id: string; from: number; to: number; order: string[] }
onReorder.when: a row is dropped at a new position, by pointer or keyboard (List prop). from and to are zero-based; order is the full new order. Not called for a drop in place or a cancel.

onAction.when: a row action is activated (ListRow prop); a swipe row closes afterwards

onOpenChange.when: swipe actions: the row opens or closes by swipe, tap, Escape, outside press or focus entering the tray (ListRow prop)

onAdd.when: the add row is activated (ListAddRow prop)

keyboard.Tab: moves through the row triggers and the controls inside rows in DOM order. Selection single: one tab stop (the checked row, or the first row when nothing is checked); multiple: every row. Reorder: the handles. Actions: the tools and the tray actions (focus inside the tray opens a swipe row).
keyboard.Enter: activates the focused trigger, handle, action or add row
keyboard.Space: activates the focused trigger (selects / toggles a choice), picks a row up or drops it from its handle
keyboard.ArrowDown / ArrowRight, ArrowUp / ArrowL: selection single: move focus to the next / previous row and select it (wraps). Reorder, handle not picked up: previous / next handle; picked up (Up / Down): move the row one position, stopping at the ends
keyboard.Home / End: selection single: first / last row, selects it. Reorder, picked up: move the row to the first / last position
keyboard.Escape: reorder: cancel a pick-up (the row returns, onReorder is not called). Swipe actions: close the row and return focus to it
keyboard.Blur: reorder: losing focus while picked up cancels, same as Escape

notes: The list is a real ul with role="list" and li rows. The heading title names it through aria-labelledby; without a heading, pass aria-label.
The stretched trigger is named by the row title (aria-labelledby), and its description by aria-describedby when a description exists. The chevron, tile, glyph, orb and marks are decorative.
A row that is not a link or a button (a settings row with a Switch) has no trigger; the control inside the row has its own accessible name.

Selection: single mode is a radio group (root role radiogroup, triggers role radio with aria-checked, roving tabindex); multiple mode is a group of checkboxes (root role group, triggers role checkbox). The root is labelled by the heading or aria-label (required in a selection). The checked state is carried by aria-checked and the mark, never by colour alone.

Reorder: dragging is never the only way. Every handle is a real button named by handleLabel ("Reorder <title>"), with aria-pressed while picked up and aria-describedby pointing to the hidden instruction. The live region announces "Picked up Lagoon, position 1 of 4", "Moved to position 2 of 4", "Dropped at position 2 of 4" and "Cancelled, back at position 1 of 4" (the consumer's announce). Position numbers are visual; the drop position is shown by geometry (the open slot), and the held row is lifted, not only recoloured. No built-in English: handleLabel, instructions and announce are supplied by the consumer.

Row actions: swiping is never the only way. The tray actions are real buttons in the tab order after the row content and focusing one opens the row; a closed tray stays in the DOM. Hover tools are IconButtons named by the action label and reachable by Tab (focus within the row shows them). Destructive actions use the danger tone and a label that names the outcome; confirm irreversible ones with an alert dialog. Reduced motion: the body jumps to its open position.
The working status is carried by the description text as well as the orb; the danger tone by the label text too (Leave workspace).
Meta text (description, value, end) is text.tertiary, which passes 4.5:1 on the surface. Tile glyphs use the on colour of their identity fill.

parts.description: One nested entry. On depth 2 it may hold its own sub list (a disclosure, with the chevron); on depth 3 sub is ignored (dropped silently in production; console.warn in development).

onSelect.when: an item is activated by pointer, Enter or Space (ListNavigationItem prop; for rows that switch a view in place, such as pages and sessions)

onAdd.when: the add button of a group is activated (ListNavigationGroup prop, with addLabel)

onExpandedChange.when: a disclosure item or sub-item is activated; the argument is the new expanded state (ListNavigationItem / ListNavigationSubItem prop)

keyboard.Enter / Space: activates the focused item: a link navigates, a disclosure toggles its children

notes: A nav landmark with ul / li groups. The current page uses aria-current="page"; do not rely on the raised surface alone.

A disclosure item is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to its sub list; the chevron is decorative. A level-2 sub-item with children works the same way; nested lists are ul inside the parent li, so the levels are exposed by the list structure.
The nesting guide is decorative (a pseudo-element).
The hot count is an accent pill with the number as text; give the link a name that includes the meaning when it matters ("Sessions, 3 need attention") with aria-label or visually hidden text.
Section headings label the group that follows (aria-labelledby on the ul).
Contrast: text.secondary on the sidebar surface, text.primary on the raised current item and accent.on on accent.solid pass their thresholds.

Session status is stated in text, not by colour alone: the meta shows "now", "Review", "Failed" or the time, and the label starts with a visually hidden status word ("Running: …", "Needs review: …", "Failed: …", "Done: …"). The orb stops rotating under reduced motion (P8). info.graphic and danger.graphic dots pass the 3:1 non-text rule.
A session column that is not site navigation uses as="div" (role group with the aria-label), so a sidebar does not gain one landmark per session list. The current row still uses aria-current="page".
The add button has no built-in English: addLabel is supplied by the consumer.

node-graph.name: NodeGraph
node-graph.intent: A canvas of positioned nodes with ports and measured wires, for state machines, flows and composition maps.

consider.when: the nodes are design tokens in three tiers with tracing

guidance: Node positions, edge states and labels are your data; the graph measures the port dots and draws the wires.
Use state on nodes, ports and edges for run progress (active, done, failed); set tone for the active colour.
Wires and port dots are decorative, so give each node a text name and list its links where a screen reader can reach them.
