number-field.name: NumberField
number-field.intent: The value field for numbers: scrub the label, step with arrows, commit on Enter, with mixed, locked and invalid states.

consider.when: a bounded range is easier to judge by position than by number
the digits are free text such as a phone number or an ID

guidance: Use commitMode "release" in editors so one scrub or drag commits once and makes one undo step.
For small whole-number quantities in forms, use appearance="stepper".

tone.description: Colour family of the field fill (soft) or edge (solid, outline). States win over it: focus, invalid, locked, reserved and disabled draw as before.

variant.description: Field emphasis. soft (default) = the neutral.well fill (a hue takes its soft 3, soft-hover 4 under the pointer); solid = surface.base with a border.default edge (a hue: its border 6); outline = no fill, the tone border 6 edge; ghost = no fill or edge until hover (the tone has no effect).

radius.description: Corner radius of the field by radius token. Default lg.

shadow.description: Elevation of the field. Default none.

size.description: Field height and value type: xs 22 / hint · sm 24 / footnote · md 28 / footnote · lg 36 / ui (compact control heights). stepper: the form heights xs 32 (control-md) / sm 36 / md 40 / lg 44, buttons 28 / 32 / 40 / 48 and input 48 / 64 / 64 / 72 wide, xs ui-sm and lg ui-lg type. hex: xs 24 / mono-sm, sm 28 / mono-md, md 32 / mono-md, lg 40 / mono.

appearance.description: scrub (default) = the inspector field: optional scrub label, value, unit, trailing. stepper = the form quantity field (was StepperInput): − and + buttons around a centred value, reads Field (id, describedBy, required, invalid, disabled); unset variant is outline and unset radius its own xl, so it renders as StepperInput did. An empty stepper starts stepping from min.

format.description: number (default) = a finite number. hex = 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits without #, typed text drops # and non-hex characters, commits uppercase, value and onValueChange are strings; the look is the hex field (uppercase mono, the sunken well with no hover, the accent bound chip). HexInput is the named preset. Arrow keys and the scrub do not apply.

parse.description: Replaces the format parser (text to value; null = syntax error). Blank text is handled before it (empty, or the mixed value).

formatValue.description: Replaces the format formatter (value to text).

token.description: hex only: the token path the paint is bound to; replaces the input by the bound chip (link icon + path).

commitMode.description: Value model. live (default, the behavior before K2d): every arrow step and scrub step raises onValueChange, a typed value is clamped to min and max on Enter or blur, and unreadable text is dropped on blur. release: typed text is a draft; it commits only when it is valid (a number inside min and max) on Enter or blur, and an unreadable or out-of-range draft stays in the field, marks it invalid and is reported, never clamped or dropped. A scrub drag raises onPreviewChange while it moves and onValueChange once on release. An arrow step is a discrete commit in both modes.

mixedLabel.description: Text shown (as placeholder) while mixed is true. Required whenever mixed can be true; no built-in default.

disabled.description: Disables the input and the scrub label: not focusable, disabled fill and text, no event. Differs from reserved, which keeps focus and the text.

reserved.description: A write to this field is in flight, or another window holds it (an Axiom field reservation). The field is read-only like locked but stays focusable and keeps its text and any draft; it sets aria-busy="true" and data-reserved. No event is raised while it is true. When it becomes false the field shows the value prop again.

label.description: Optional scrub handle (scrub appearance only).

step.description: Step for arrows, scrub and the stepper buttons (Shift ×10, Alt ×0.1).

onScrubStart.when: K2e: a pointer press on the scrub label starts, before any movement and also when it never moves. Lets an owner acquire the field reservation at pointer down as it does on focus. Not raised while the field is reserved, locked or disabled.

onDraftChange.payload: { text: string; value: number | null; error: 'empty' | 'syntax' | 'range' | null; dirty: boolean }
onDraftChange.when: the text of the field changes by typing, paste or Escape, and when a commit clears it. value is the parsed number or null; error is empty (blank text on a field that is not mixed), syntax (not a finite number) or range (outside min and max; only in release mode, live clamps instead); dirty is true while the text differs from the committed value. A commit or Escape reports dirty false and error null. Blank text while mixed is true is not an error: the mixed value is kept, nothing is committed, and the report is error null with dirty false (the field keeps showing the mixed label).

onPreviewChange.when: commitMode release only: a scrub drag moves the value (one step per 2px) without committing; null when the drag ends or Escape cancels it. onValueChange follows once, on release, when the value changed.

onValueChange.when: a step, scrub, stepper button or committed edit changes the value (a string of uppercase digits with format hex)

keyboard.Escape: revert

notes: The scrub label is aria-hidden; give the input an aria-label. A stepper takes its name from Field (or aria-label); its buttons are named Decrease and Increase and stay out of the tab order. A hex field is named by aria-label ("Hex", "Stroke color"); its bound chip is not focusable.
aria-invalid is always written: "true" while the text is an invalid draft or invalid is set, "false" otherwise (the attribute is not removed), so a script can read the state either way.
reserved sets aria-busy="true" on the root and keeps the input focusable (aria-readonly="true"); disabled uses the native disabled attribute.
An invalid draft is not color-only: the owner shows the reason as text next to the field (Field error, role=alert) from the onDraftChange payload.

The row action labels are a stem the row name is appended to ("Hide" → "Hide Linear") or a builder (n => "Hide " + n). styles and add the header buttons ("Styles", "Add fill"; add is drawn while set), mixedPaints and replaceAll the mixed summary, opacity the aria-label of the paint opacity field, mixed the mixed opacity placeholder, detailClose the popover close button.

limits.type: { opacity?: { min?: number | undefined; max?: number | undefined; step?: number | undefined } }
limits.description: K2e: range and step of the opacity field; default 0 to 100, step 1.

mixed.description: Show the mixed summary instead of the rows (multi-selection with differing paints).

onFieldBlur.type: (event: { field: "opacity"; id: string; dirty: boolean; }) => void

onItemChange.type: (change: { id: string; opacity?: number | undefined; hidden?: boolean | undefined; }) => void

onPreviewChange.type: (preview: { id: string; opacity: number; } | null) => void

openItem.description: K2e: controlled id of the item whose detail is open; null closes all. The owner vetoes a close by not updating it (an invalid draft inside the editor).

radius.description: Common prop. Corner radius of the root. Default none.

reserved.description: true reserves the whole stack (add, styles and every row, aria-busy on the root); a record keyed by item id reserves that row: its actions and opacity field are inert with aria-busy="true" and data-reserved, the row stays readable and selecting it for editing still works.

selected.description: Id of the item being edited (shown in an editor below the list): that row gets aria-current="true" and the selected inversion. Unset: no row is marked (an open effect detail marks its row too).

shadow.description: Common prop. Elevation of the root. Default none.

size.description: Common prop. Titled: section rhythm: xs 8 / 6 · sm 10 / 8 · md the panel rhythm (12 / 8 in an md panel) · lg 16 / 12 (padding / gap); the title stays the caption role. Untitled: forwarded to every StackRow (row height and label type); for kind effect it also steps the row gap: xs 0, sm 2, md 4, lg 8.

summaryNote.description: K2e: explanatory text under the mixed summary (what Replace all will do).

title.description: Section title ("Fill", "Fill · 3 selected", "Effects"). No built-in default (K2d). Omitted: the bare list without section, header or add button.

tone.description: Common prop. Titled: the section (title, edge or fill). Untitled: forwarded to every StackRow.

variant.description: Common prop. Titled: the section emphasis (ghost bare, solid raised, soft tone soft, outline tone edge). Untitled: forwarded to every StackRow.

tone.description: Titled: the colour family of the section in the non-default emphasis: the title (ghost), the edge (solid, outline) or the fill (soft). Untitled: forwarded to every StackRow (see stack-row).

variant.description: Titled: ghost (default) = the bare InspectorSection (a hue colours the title); solid = on surface.raised (a hue adds its border 6 edge); soft = on the tone soft 3; outline = the tone border 6 edge. Untitled: forwarded to every StackRow (ghost = no fill until hover, soft = the tone soft row, outline = a 1px tone edge, solid = a raised control row).

radius.description: Corner radius of the root by radius token (the section, or the bare list root; rows keep their own md radius). Default none.

shadow.description: Elevation of the root. Default none.

onFieldFocus.when: K2e: focus enters the opacity field of a layer or a scrub starts on it; the owner acquires its reservation.

onFieldBlur.when: K2e: focus leaves it; dirty while an invalid draft stays.

onFieldCommit.payload: { field: 'opacity'; id: string; value: number } | { field: 'visibility'; id: string; value: boolean }
onFieldCommit.when: K2e: one item field commits, before onItemChange. Returning false rejects it (draft kept, that opacity field marked invalid, onItemChange not raised).

onOpenItemChange.when: K2e: a layer well (paint) or a row with a detail (effect) was pressed (its id), the detail popover was dismissed or its close button pressed (null). With openItem the owner decides whether it opens or closes.

onMove.when: a row move-up or move-down action is pressed. The move actions are drawn only while onMove is passed; the first row cannot move up and the last cannot move down (the action is disabled, not removed).

onDraftChange.payload: { field: 'opacity'; text: string; value: number | null; error: 'empty' | 'syntax' | 'range' | null; dirty: boolean }
onDraftChange.when: a numeric field text changes (NumberField contract: error empty, syntax or range, dirty while it differs from the committed value). field names the field. The payload carries the item id as well: { id }.

onPreviewChange.when: commitMode release only: a scrub or drag gesture is in progress, with the value being previewed (not a commit); null when it ends or Escape cancels it. onValueChange follows once on release.

onItemChange.payload: { id: string; opacity?: number; hidden?: boolean }
onItemChange.when: an item opacity is committed (valid Enter or blur, release of a scrub, an arrow step) or its visibility toggled. It is the commit of this part (K2d); onItemOpen and onSelect do not commit.

onRemove.when: an item remove button is pressed; the payload is its id

onItemOpen.when: a paint swatch is pressed (open the picker)

onSelect.when: a row is pressed outside its controls, or Enter / Space on a focused row; the owner shows that item in the editor

onReplaceAll.when: Replace all is pressed on the mixed summary

keyboard.Tab: paint: styles, add, then each row (swatch, opacity, visibility, remove). effect: each row (a tab stop while onSelect is set or it has a detail), then its visibility and remove actions
keyboard.Enter / Space: on a focused row: select it for editing (onSelect) and, for an effect with a detail, open or close it

notes: A titled stack is a group labelled by its title; the rows are a list (role list, named by labels.list) so the count is announced.
Each row exposes its value as text (name and detail), not only through the swatch or icon; the action labels carry the row name ("Hide drop shadow").
With onSelect (or an effect detail) the row itself is focusable (tabIndex 0, focus ring) and Enter or Space selects it, so choosing the item to edit does not need a pointer.

onReorder.when: an item is dropped at a new position (pointer drop or keyboard drop). from and to are zero-based; order is the full new order. Not called for a drop in place or a cancel.

keyboard.Tab: moves through the rows in DOM order
keyboard.ArrowUp / ArrowDown (not picked up): move focus to the previous or next row

slider.name: Slider
slider.intent: Set a number on a range by dragging, or step through a few named levels.

consider.when: the exact value matters more than the feel of dragging
a few levels should all be readable as labels at once
it edits one channel of a colour inside a colour picker

guidance: label with field makes the inspector row with a synced number field; bare, it is the control alone.
Gradient and alpha tracks show the sampled colour in the thumb; pass thumbColor for the current value.

tone.description: Colour of the chosen amount: range, ruler line and knob, marks, the current dot, lit bars (accent by default).

variant.description: Track or discrete form (see variants).

radius.description: Track corner (bars: the button corner). xs (the default) keeps the own corner; another value sets it.

shadow.description: Track elevation (bars: the button elevation); unset is flat.

size.description: Root height 12 · 16 · 20 · 26 with thumb 10 · 12 · 16 · 20 (xs, sm, md, lg); the bar is 2px at xs, 4px at sm and md, 6px at lg. The ruler is 30px at every size. Row: also the gap (8, 10, 10, 12) and the label type (ui-xs, hint, hint, ui-sm). Levels: the strip height. Dots: 6 · 8 · 10 · 12px.

value.description: Controlled value (with levels: the level index).

defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial value; min by default (with levels: 0).

step.description: Keyboard and drag step. Shift+Arrow and PageUp/PageDown move ten steps.

appearance.description: Deprecated alias of variant: default = solid; the other names are the same.

gradient.description: CSS gradient painted on the track for gradient and alpha, e.g. "linear-gradient(90deg, …)".

thumbColor.description: CSS color shown inside the thumb for gradient and alpha; the color at the current value.

disabled.description: Disables the slider (and the field).

label.description: Row label in the left column; with levels the caption in the header. A string label also names the slider and the field (aria-label wins for abbreviations such as L, C, H).

field.description: Adds a NumberField after the slider, synced to the value (was SliderField). An object passes NumberField props (className, size, invalid…) through; value, bounds and the value model below come from the Slider.

unit.description: Unit suffix in the field (%, °, px).

fieldScale.description: The field shows value / fieldScale (e.g. 100 shows 17 as 0.17 for OKLCH chroma).

reserved.description: A write is in flight or another window holds the value: the slider is inert (aria-disabled, data-reserved) and the field is reserved (read-only, aria-busy); the label stays.

mixed.description: The selection has several values: the thumb rests at the minimum with aria-valuetext set to mixedLabel and data-mixed, and the field is mixed. No value is invented; moving the slider or committing the field sets one for the whole selection.

mixedLabel.description: Placeholder of the field and aria-valuetext of the thumb while mixed. Required whenever mixed can be true; no built-in default.

commitMode.description: live (default): every slider move raises onValueChange. release: a drag raises onPreviewChange while it moves and onValueChange once on release (a keyboard step or a click on the track commits at once); the field follows the NumberField release contract (invalid text stays a draft).

levels.description: Discrete mode (was StepSlider): names of the levels, e.g. ["Low","Medium","High","Max"]. The value is the level index; the track snaps to it, draws one mark per level and the header shows the current name. dots and bars use the names too; without levels they step min..max by step.

endLabels.description: Levels: captions under the track ends, e.g. ["Faster","Deeper"].

appearance.description: Deprecated alias of variant: default = solid; the other names are the same.

commitMode.description: live (default): every slider move raises onValueChange. release: a drag raises onPreviewChange while it moves and onValueChange once on release (a keyboard step or a click on the track commits at once); the field follows the NumberField release contract (invalid text stays a draft).

defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial value; min by default (with levels: 0).

disabled.description: Disables the slider (and the field).

endLabels.description: Levels: captions under the track ends, e.g. ["Faster","Deeper"].

field.description: Adds a NumberField after the slider, synced to the value (was SliderField). An object passes NumberField props (className, size, invalid…) through; value, bounds and the value model below come from the Slider.

fieldScale.description: The field shows value / fieldScale (e.g. 100 shows 17 as 0.17 for OKLCH chroma).

gradient.description: CSS gradient painted on the track for gradient and alpha, e.g. "linear-gradient(90deg, …)".

label.description: Row label in the left column; with levels the caption in the header. A string label also names the slider and the field (aria-label wins for abbreviations such as L, C, H).

levels.description: Discrete mode (was StepSlider): names of the levels, e.g. ["Low","Medium","High","Max"]. The value is the level index; the track snaps to it, draws one mark per level and the header shows the current name. dots and bars use the names too; without levels they step min..max by step.

mixed.description: The selection has several values: the thumb rests at the minimum with aria-valuetext set to mixedLabel and data-mixed, and the field is mixed. No value is invented; moving the slider or committing the field sets one for the whole selection.

mixedLabel.description: Placeholder of the field and aria-valuetext of the thumb while mixed. Required whenever mixed can be true; no built-in default.

radius.description: Track corner (bars: the button corner). xs (the default) keeps the own corner; another value sets it.

reserved.description: A write is in flight or another window holds the value: the slider is inert (aria-disabled, data-reserved) and the field is reserved (read-only, aria-busy); the label stays.

shadow.description: Track elevation (bars: the button elevation); unset is flat.

size.description: Root height 12 · 16 · 20 · 26 with thumb 10 · 12 · 16 · 20 (xs, sm, md, lg); the bar is 2px at xs, 4px at sm and md, 6px at lg. The ruler is 30px at every size. Row: also the gap (8, 10, 10, 12) and the label type (ui-xs, hint, hint, ui-sm). Levels: the strip height. Dots: 6 · 8 · 10 · 12px.

step.description: Keyboard and drag step. Shift+Arrow and PageUp/PageDown move ten steps.

thumbColor.description: CSS color shown inside the thumb for gradient and alpha; the color at the current value.

tone.description: Colour of the chosen amount: range, ruler line and knob, marks, the current dot, lit bars (accent by default).

unit.description: Unit suffix in the field (%, °, px).

value.description: Controlled value (with levels: the level index).

variant.description: Track or discrete form (see variants).

tone.description: Colour of the range, the ruler line and knob, the filled and current marks, the current dot and the lit bars (accent by default). The thumb stays the control thumb.

variant.description: Track. solid = neutral.track bar with the tone solid range (default); soft = the tone soft bar; outline = a 1px tone border edge, no bar fill; ghost = the range alone; the own tracks: gradient = any colour ramp (hue, channel), alpha = gradient over a checkerboard, ruler = tick marks with a line thumb; the discrete forms: dots = a radio row of dots, bars = a compact trigger with a three-bar glyph and the level name. levels use the solid, soft, outline or ghost bar (the own tracks are continuous and draw solid). appearance (deprecated): default = solid.

radius.description: Track corner (the bars button corner for bars). xs (the default) keeps the own corner (xs bar, sm gradient / alpha, lg at lg, none ruler, md bars); another value sets it.

shadow.description: Track elevation (the bars button elevation for bars); unset is flat.

onValueChange.when: the value changes by drag, click on the track or keyboard

onValueCommit.when: the user releases the thumb or finishes a keyboard step; a discrete level is chosen

onDraftChange.payload: { text: string; value: number | null; error: 'empty' | 'syntax' | 'range' | null; dirty: boolean }
onDraftChange.when: the field text changes (NumberField contract); value is in slider units after fieldScale is applied

onPreviewChange.when: commitMode release only: the slider is being dragged; the value in slider units, null when the drag ends

onClick.when: bars: the button is activated; the caller opens its menu (the value does not change)

notes: The thumb has role=slider; give it aria-label (or aria-labelledby the row label). A string label names the slider and the field.
The 12px sm thumb sits in a 16px root; extend the hit area with a transparent pseudo-element so the pointer target is at least 24px.
Color alone must not be the only cue for the value: pair gradient sliders with a numeric field.
Levels: the strip (control) has role=slider with aria-valuenow = level index, aria-valuetext = level name and a single tab stop.
Dots: the root has role=radiogroup; each dot is role=radio with aria-label (its level name); the 10px dots extend their hit area to at least 24px.
Bars: a button with aria-haspopup="menu"; its text names the level, the glyph is aria-hidden.

stepper.name: Stepper
stepper.intent: Show progress through a sequence of steps, or the live checklist of what the agent will do.

consider.when: it is the agent plan with its header
the user moves freely between sections in any order
it records what already happened, newest first

guidance: It only shows progress; pair it with buttons or tabs for moving between steps.
The checklist look with tone="agent" lights the running step; the spectrum stays for agent work.
stepper.import: import { Stepper, StepperCount, StepperHeader, StepperTitle } from '@caustic/react';

value.description: Current step, 1-based, for steps without a status. Earlier steps are done, later ones upcoming. 0 = none started. State probes: checked = first item done (value 2), selected = first item current (value 1), unchecked = first item upcoming (value 0).

steps.type: { id?: string; label: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; status?: 'done' | 'now' | 'todo' | 'failed'; detail?: ReactNode }[]
steps.description: The steps in order. status overrides the value index for that step; description belongs to the progress look, detail to the checklist.

title.description: Heading of the steps: renders StepperHeader with StepperTitle (and StepperCount when countLabel is set) and names the root group.

countLabel.description: Text of the count (e.g. (d, t) => `${d} of ${t}`). Supplied by the consumer so it can be translated and pluralized; no built-in default.

statusLabels.type: { done?: string; now?: string; todo?: string; failed?: string }
statusLabels.description: Visually hidden status word read with each step (e.g. "Done", "In progress", "To do", "Failed"). Without it the progress look keeps "completed" / "failed" on done / failed steps; the checklist reads no word.

children.description: A custom header built from StepperHeader, StepperTitle and StepperCount; replaces the one title renders. Point aria-labelledby at the title.

tone.description: Colour family of the progress; on the checklist the now mark (agent = orb).

variant.description: Done-step emphasis of the progress look, or the checklist (see variants).

radius.description: Indicator corner (progress) or card corner (checklist) by radius token; full (default) keeps the own shape: the indicator circle, the xl card.

shadow.description: Indicator elevation (progress) or card elevation (checklist) by elevation token.

size.description: Progress: indicator diameter xs 20 / sm 24 / md 28 / lg 32 (control-2xs … control-md) with ui-xs / ui-xs / ui-sm / ui numbers; connectors and the vertical column follow the diameter. Checklist: row minimum height and type xs 24 / ui-xs · sm 26 / ui-sm · md 28 / ui-dense · lg 32 / ui.

Checklist: row minimum height and type xs 24 / ui-xs · sm 26 / ui-sm · md 28 / ui-dense · lg 32 / ui.

steps.description: The steps in order. status overrides the value index for that step; description belongs to the progress look, detail to the checklist.

title.description: Heading of the steps: renders StepperHeader with StepperTitle (and StepperCount when countLabel is set) and names the root group.

tone.description: Colour family of the progress; on the checklist the now mark (agent = orb).

value.description: Current step, 1-based, for steps without a status. Earlier steps are done, later ones upcoming. 0 = none started. State probes: checked = first item done (value 2), selected = first item current (value 1), unchecked = first item upcoming (value 0).

variant.description: Done-step emphasis of the progress look, or the checklist (see variants).

orientation.description: Progress look: a row of centred steps with a connector between them, or a column with the indicator at the start. The checklist is always a column.

tone.description: Colour family of the progress: done indicators, the current ring and text, and the active connector. Checklist: the now mark; agent turns it into the spectrum orb (the agent is working). Done checks stay success and failed stays danger.

variant.description: solid / soft / outline / ghost: the progress look and the emphasis of a done step (solid = tone.solid disc with a tone.on check; soft = tone.soft disc with a tone.text check; outline = 1.5px tone.solid ring with a tone.text check; ghost = the tone.text check alone; the current step is always the 2px tone ring). checklist: the agent plan card (see root).

radius.description: Progress: corner of the indicators. Checklist: corner of the card. full (default) keeps the own shape: the indicator circle, the xl card.

shadow.description: Progress: elevation of the indicators. Checklist: elevation of the card, replacing the hairline (one depth cue).

parts.name: StepperCount
parts.description: StepperCount: "3 of 6", done steps over total, text from countLabel; tertiary, normal weight, tabular numerals; text.placeholder on the checklist (round 4).

parts.name: StepperHeader
parts.description: StepperHeader: title row, space-between; padding 4px 6px 6px; ui-sm semibold text.primary. Rendered by the title prop, or passed as children.

parts.name: StepperTitle
parts.description: StepperTitle: the name of the steps; names the root group (aria-labelledby).

notes: The current item has aria-current="step".

Colour is never the only cue: done shows a check (and, on the checklist, a strike-through), current shows the ring or the orb and medium weight, todo the number or a dashed circle, failed the danger glyph.
Progress look: done items include visually hidden "completed" text (statusLabels.done replaces it); the check icon is aria-hidden.

Checklist: each step gets a visually hidden status word from statusLabels; a visually hidden status region (role status) announces only the step that changed, so the whole list is not reread; the count text is the visible progress statement (the top edge is aria-hidden; there is no progressbar).
With a header the root is role="group" named by the title (aria-labelledby).

stroke-editor.name: StrokeEditor
stroke-editor.intent: Edit a stroke: its paint, weight and position, dash pattern and line cap, and independent widths per side.

consider.when: a layer carries several stroke paints in a list

guidance: Stroke opacity and colour alpha are separate numbers; keep both apart in your model.

tone.description: Ink of the preview line and the side box.

variant.description: Section container (see variants).

radius.description: Container corner by radius token.

shadow.description: Container elevation by elevation token.

size.description: Gap between the three sections: 8 / 10 / 12 / 16px for xs / sm / md / lg; the rows inside a section keep 6px. The composed controls keep their xs size.

invalid.description: K2e: fields the owner marks invalid (a rejected commit, a bound value that needs explicit local intent). Sets aria-invalid="true", data-invalid and the danger edge on that field only; its draft and value stay. Independent of a rejection the part tracks itself through onFieldCommit returning false.

describedBy.description: K2e: id of the owner error or hint text per field (aria-describedby on the field input).

limits.type: Partial<Record<'weight' | 'dash' | 'gap' | 'miterLimit' | 'opacity' | 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left', { min?: number | undefined; max?: number | undefined; step?: number | undefined }>>
limits.description: K2e: per-field range and step from the owner (a size is 0 or more, letter spacing steps 0.1). Defaults are the specimen values. A typed value outside the range is a range draft error in release mode and is clamped in live mode.

children.description: K2e: extra owner rows appended after the independent widths block (the owner stroke geometry rows), spaced by the same gap (a details popover trigger, size limits, points, arcs, a transform matrix). They are outside every field contract and render nothing by default.

value.type: { color: { hex: string; alpha: number }; weight: number; position: 'inside' | 'center' | 'outside'; dash: number; gap: number; dashPattern?: number[]; cap: 'butt' | 'round' | 'square' | 'arrow' | 'arrow-filled'; join?: 'miter' | 'round' | 'bevel'; miterLimit?: number; opacity?: number; independent: boolean; sides: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number } }
value.description: Controlled stroke.

defaultValue.type: { color: { hex: string; alpha: number }; weight: number; position: 'inside' | 'center' | 'outside'; dash: number; gap: number; dashPattern?: number[]; cap: 'butt' | 'round' | 'square' | 'arrow' | 'arrow-filled'; join?: 'miter' | 'round' | 'bevel'; miterLimit?: number; opacity?: number; independent: boolean; sides: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number } }

disabled.description: true disables every control; a record disables the named fields.

commitMode.description: live (default): the behavior before K2d. release: the NumberField value model for every numeric field of this part, and one commit per continuous gesture. The weight, dash, gap and side fields and the color paint well follow the release contract.

mixed.description: Fields whose selection values differ; each shows labels.mixed in place of a value (text fields as placeholder, toggles with aria-pressed "mixed", selects as the select value) and never a substituted first value.

reserved.description: Fields that are being written or held by another window: read-only, aria-busy="true", data-reserved, focus and draft kept, no event while reserved.

labels.type: { color: { well: string; hex: string; alpha: string; detach: string; mixed: string }; weight: string; positionGroup: string; position: Record<'inside' | 'center' | 'outside', string>; details: string; dash: string; gap: string; capsGroup: string; caps: Record<'butt' | 'round' | 'arrow', string>; independent: string; independentSwitch: string; sidesGroup: string; sides: Record<'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left', string>; sidesShort: Record<'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left', string>; opacity?: string; joinGroup?: string; join?: Record<'miter' | 'round' | 'bevel', string>; dashPattern?: string; dashPatternPlaceholder?: string; miterLimit?: string; capExtra?: { square?: string; 'arrow-filled'?: string }; mixed: string }

The specimen values: "Stroke color", "Stroke hex", "Opacity", Weight, In, Center, Out, "Stroke details", Dash, Gap, Butt cap, Round cap, Arrow cap, "Independent stroke widths", "Independent widths", Top, Left, Right, Bottom and the letters T, L, R, B.

tone.description: Ink of the preview line and the side box.

value.description: Controlled stroke.

variant.description: Section container (see variants).

tone.description: Ink of the dash preview line and the side-width box (tone graphic; neutral.graphic by default). The composed controls keep their own colours.

variant.description: Section container: ghost = none (the specimen; the inspector panel draws the surface); soft = neutral.well fill; outline = 1px border.subtle hairline; solid = surface.raised fill. The three containers pad 12px.

radius.description: Container corner; none is the own (no container).

shadow.description: Container elevation; none keeps it flat.

onFieldFocus.when: K2e: focus enters a field, or a scrub or drag starts on its label (NumberField onScrubStart). The owner acquires that field reservation here. Not raised while the field is reserved or disabled.

onFieldBlur.when: K2e: focus leaves a field after its commit decision. dirty is true while an invalid or uncommitted draft stays in it, so the owner keeps the reservation and the selection guard.

onFieldCommit.payload: { field: 'weight' | 'dash' | 'gap' | 'miterLimit' | 'opacity' | 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'; value: number } | { field: 'position' | 'cap' | 'join'; value: string } | { field: 'independent'; value: boolean } | { field: 'dashPattern'; value: number[] } | { field: 'color'; value: { hex: string; alpha: number } }
onFieldCommit.when: K2e: exactly one field commits (valid Enter or blur, release of a scrub, an arrow step, a discrete choice). Raised before onValueChange. The handler may return false to reject: the part keeps the draft, marks that field invalid until the next edit, Escape or a new value prop, shows the value prop again for a discrete control, and does not raise onValueChange.

onDraftChange.payload: { field: 'weight' | 'dash' | 'gap' | 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'; text: string; value: number | null; error: 'empty' | 'syntax' | 'range' | null; dirty: boolean }
onDraftChange.when: a numeric field text changes (NumberField contract: error empty, syntax or range, dirty while it differs from the committed value). field names the field. The color paint well drafts are forwarded with field color and the PaintWell payload under draft. K2e: the dashPattern field reports the comma list as text, value is number[] or null, error is empty, syntax or range (a negative length, or no length above 0).

onPreviewChange.when: commitMode release only: a scrub or drag gesture is in progress, with the value being previewed (not a commit); null when it ends or Escape cancels it. onValueChange follows once on release.

onValueChange.when: any control commits; with independent off, weight is the single width

keyboard.Tab: color, hex, opacity, weight, position, details, dash, gap, caps, join, layer opacity, miter limit, independent, side fields

notes: The cap and position segments are radio groups; icon-only cap items need aria-labels (Butt cap, Round cap, Arrow cap).
The side fields are labelled Top / Left / Right / Bottom; the box is decorative (aria-hidden).

keyboard.ArrowDown / ArrowUp: single: move focus and choose the next / previous entry (selection follows focus, wrapping)
keyboard.Home / End: single: choose the first / last entry
keyboard.Enter / Space: single: choose the focused entry; on Restore: activate it

The author is carried by the title or the sentence ("Caustic · …", "Mina commented …"), not only by the node; the spine, node and icon disc are decorative. An Avatar marker keeps its own name, which repeats the actor: mark it aria-hidden at the call site to avoid reading the name twice.
Item Restore is a Button ghost xs (24px hit) named with context ("Restore Mina · Pro card copy"); its confirm step is a named group whose Cancel takes focus, and Escape closes it.
The footer Restore is named "Restore this version"; when disabled its reason is the note, linked with aria-describedby.
Time is a time element with a datetime where known.
The spectrum dot rotates only while running and stops under reduced motion (P8).
If entries are added live, put the timeline in a region with aria-live="polite" at the call site.

Text is text.primary and text.secondary over regular glass; contrast is checked against the glass fill.

parts.name: TokenGraphNode
parts.description: One token. A button positioned absolutely at left x% / top y% (the --x and --y custom properties). 150px wide, 7px / 10px padding, lg radius, base surface with a hairline edge and no elevation (one depth cue), grid with a 2px gap. aria-pressed = traced. data-missing on a missing reference. data-dimmed when another node is traced and this one is off the trace (border.subtle hairline, text.tertiary name). Press traces the node (onValueChange).

parts.name: TokenGraphTier
parts.description: Tier caption ("Primitive", "Semantic", "Component") at the top of the canvas, 10px from the top; at 16px from the left, at 38%, or 16px from the right (the at prop). Caption role (uppercase, tracked), tertiary.

onValueChange.when: a node is pressed (id of the node to trace)

keyboard.Tab: moves through the nodes in tier order (left to right, top to bottom)
keyboard.Enter / Space: traces the focused node (and keeps focus on it)
keyboard.ArrowRight / ArrowLeft: move focus to a connected node downstream / upstream (nearest by vertical position); nothing when there is none
keyboard.ArrowDown / ArrowUp: move focus to the next / previous node in the same tier

notes: Nodes are native buttons with aria-pressed (traced). Each node's accessible description lists its sources and consumers ("depends on color.accent.7, color.accent.5; used by button.accent.bg") so the graph is available without the wires.
A missing reference is stated in text ("missing reference") and the node name is read as is; the danger color is not the only signal.
Port dots and wires are decorative.
The traced state is not only color: aria-pressed, the 1.5px accent ring and the thicker wires all change.
Tier captions are visual groupers; they are also exposed as the tier of each node in its description.

tool-call.name: ToolCall
tool-call.intent: One tool the agent ran, shown in the transcript as running, done with its time, or failed with a reason.

consider.when: many calls are grouped under the plan steps that made them
the work is not an agent tool, just a running task

guidance: Pass progress only when the tool reports it; never simulate a percentage.
Put the result (a diff, a log line, the failure detail) in children to make the call expandable.

activity.description: Running label (e.g. "Running", "Deriving"). Required whenever status is running; no built-in default.

failedLabel.description: Status text of a failed call (e.g. "Failed"). Required whenever status is failed; no built-in default. Optional in the type only because it is unused for the other statuses.

progressLabel.description: Builds the aria-label of the progress bar from the tool name (e.g. n => `${n} progress`). Required whenever progress is given; no built-in default.

tone.description: Colour of the tool icon.

variant.description: Card look (see variants).

radius.description: Card corner by radius token.

shadow.description: Card elevation by elevation token.

size.description: Header height and type: 28 ui-xs / 32 ui-sm / 40 ui-dense (the specimen) / 48 ui.

the hint points at something on the design canvas

notes: Every user-visible or announced string is a prop (label, zoomOutLabel, zoomInLabel) and there is no English default; the examples pass "Zoom", "Zoom out" and "Zoom in". agent-session.title: Agent session
agent-session.intent: A coding or design session with an agent: past sessions, the live transcript and a review pane for what changed.

regions.purpose: Sessions grouped by day, with run status, plus checkpoints the user can restore.
A slim header over the transcript: session title, where it runs, its live status and options.
The exchange itself: messages, reasoning, tool calls, the plan, diffs and requests for approval.
The prompt area pinned under the transcript: suggested next prompts and the composer with context chips.
Review of the agent work: preview, revisions, structural changes, policy findings, context use and model.

notes: Keep the transcript in one centred column (about 42rem) so prose, tool calls and diffs share one reading line.
Agent tone and spectrum light appear only on agent things: its messages, requests, cursor and its own actions.
Questions the agent asks inline use ChoiceGroup appearance="answer"; approvals use AgentRequest, not a dialog.
Hide the side panels at narrow widths before shrinking the transcript.

analytics-dashboard.title: Analytics dashboard
analytics-dashboard.intent: An admin analytics page: filters, headline metrics, charts, a sortable account table and an activity feed.

regions.purpose: Page header with the title, the data freshness line and the page-level actions.
A dismissible page alert when the data is incomplete or stale, with a recovery action.
One filter bar for the whole page: search, pickers, a date range, plan and status toggles, tags.
A row of headline metrics, each with its change and a short trend.
Charts inside cards, with a small switch for the measure shown and a short summary under the chart.
The account table: sort, select, page, row menus, status badges and an empty state when filters match nothing.
Recent activity by people and the agent, paged, beside a card that is still loading.

notes: There is no chart component: draw charts with the chart-1 to chart-6 colour tokens inside a Card.
One primary action in the page header; the other header and toolbar actions stay secondary or ghost.
Filters reset the table to page one and offer a way to clear them all.
Show loading with Skeleton in the final layout, not a spinner over the page.

canvas-review.title: Canvas review
canvas-review.intent: Review a design change on the canvas: before and after, comments, where the agent worked, and the findings.

regions.purpose: The frames under review, with comment pins and the agent work area over what it changed.
A before and after comparison of one frame, side by side or with a split divider.
Floating review tools: comment, compare, zoom.
What changed and what to decide: structural and token changes, policy and contrast findings, the approval.

notes: Show agent edits with AgentWorkArea and AgentCursor so they never read as the user’s own selection.
Token changes read best in TokenDiff; line-level code changes belong in CodeDiff.
Approve or reject through AgentRequest in the panel, close to the findings it depends on.

design-editor.title: Design editor
design-editor.intent: A canvas design tool: titlebar, pages and layers, the canvas with its marks and floating tools, and an inspector.

regions.purpose: File name and sync state, undo and redo, the editor mode switch, collaborators and Share.
Pages and the layer tree, with a filter field, in a tabbed side panel.
Rulers, frames and their labels, the selection, guides, comments and the agent cursor.
Floating tools over the canvas: the tool bar, selection actions, key hints and zoom.
Properties of the selection in sections: frame, auto layout, fill, radius, effects, layer and export.

notes: AppShell owns the frame: put content in its Titlebar, Start, Stage, End and Overlay parts, not in your own grid.
Canvas marks take canvas coordinates through rect; floating bars and hints go in AppShellOverlay.
The human selection is accent with square handles; agent work is the spectrum rim plus the agent cursor.
One accent action in the titlebar (Share); the rest of the chrome stays neutral.

design-to-code.title: Design to code
design-to-code.intent: An agent turns a frame into code: its phases, the rendered result against the design, and the code it wrote.

regions.purpose: The request and the agent’s progress through its phases, with tool calls as they run.
The design frame next to the rendered code, to judge fidelity.
The generated code as a diff the user accepts or rejects, and the export settings.

notes: CodeRealization carries the phase strip; a separate Stepper beside it would repeat it.
Keep the accept action on the diff itself so the decision sits next to the code.

theme-editor.title: Theme and token editor
theme-editor.intent: Pick a theme, inspect how tokens resolve, edit colours and bindings, and review and export the change.

regions.purpose: The themes to start from, as selectable preview cards.
The token map: ramps as colour tiles, the alias graph and the chain of one selected token.
Edit the selected token: its colour, its binding or expression, and its contrast against its pairs.
Review the token changes, then import or export the theme in a dialog.

notes: Swatch colours are data, set through a CSS custom property; the chrome around them still uses tokens.
ColorPicker is the popover a ColorWell opens; reach for the well first, not an inline picker.

workspace-settings.title: Workspace settings
workspace-settings.intent: A settings page for a team: section navigation, forms, members, plan and billing, notifications and a danger zone.

regions.purpose: Section navigation down the side, sticky on wide screens and on top on narrow ones.
Profile forms in titled sections: upload, labelled fields with hints and errors, and one save footer.
Invite people: a list of addresses, a role picker, the send action and the confirmation.
Members and invoices as tables with identity, inline role pickers, status and row menus.
The current plan and seat use, and read-only billing details that can be copied.
Notification preferences: switches with descriptions, checkbox and radio groups, a small option toggle.
A danger zone whose destructive action asks for typed confirmation in a dialog.

notes: Each section has a SectionHeader; sections are resting surfaces with a hairline, never a shadow.
A switch applies at once; fields inside FormLayout save with its footer.
Keep one accent action on the page (the upgrade); other actions are secondary or ghost.
Destructive actions use the danger tone and confirm in a Dialog; nothing else needs a modal.
